title: EMOJI JACKPOT: Word Finder
description: EMOJI JACKPOT: Word Finder. Drag. Spell. Cash out. Word search reinvented as a pixel-art slot machine.

title: ToyOps Demo
description: A third-person action-puzzle adventure where a team of tiny toy agents explores an oversized human world, solves environmental puzzles, and uses each character's unique abilities to overcome obstacles.

title: Wife Life : Detective Demo
description: Play as a wife who is also a detective and solve a case with some erotic scene along the way!

title: 8 Hours Till Dawn Demo
description: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night

title: Last Stop Defence Demo
description: 《终点防线》是一款融合卡牌构筑、塔防与 Roguelike 元素的单人策略游戏。在敌人持续推进的棋盘上，消耗能量打出卡牌，攻击敌人、部署侍从、调整站位，守住防线。选择拥有专属卡牌与能力的英雄，在冒险中收集卡牌来构筑你的牌组，收集不同能力模块来拼放强化构筑，应对一波又一波的进攻。

title: LOVE COMPANY: A Romance Escape Demo
description: Love leaves clues. Join LOVE COMPANY, a company that delivers feelings of love. Inspect objects, follow emotional traces, and solve puzzles to uncover the truth behind those feelings in this first-person romantic mystery escape-room game.

title: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor Demo
description: The complete Picnic, free. One filthy fly, twenty waves of ants, bees, beetles and medics, nine disgusting weapons to stack and evolve, and The Crumb King waiting at the end. Die, mutate at The Heap, go again. Everything you earn carries into the full game.

title: Defeat the Demon King with a Financed Bahamut
Little Bear`s Honey Shop Demo
description: Little Bear's Honey Shop is an incremental game where you battle magical plants, gather flowers and ingredients, and craft sweet honey products. Build powerful combinations on a honeycomb skill tree, sell honey to customers, and grow a tiny shop into a bustling honey empire.

title: PixelRift Demo
description: PixelRift Demo is a demo for PixelRift, the upcoming 2D action-platformer that combines fast-paced gameplay, challenging levels, and powerful creation tools in a game filled with platforming adventures!Explore diverse realms, battle dangerous enemies, and take on epic boss encounters.

title: Questris Demo
description: Questris is a fantasy roguelite where you place pieces to complete lines that attack, defend, heal, and trigger powerful effects. Shape each run with new pieces, relics, runes, and class abilities, and adapt your strategy to the enemies you face.

title: Balloon Bus Demo
description: Balloon Bus is a casual puzzle game where you pilot adorable balloons to transport passengers. Navigate through various obstacles and safely deliver passengers to their destinations! Master the art of balloon piloting and enjoy this delightful adventure for all ages.

title: Plamo Kits Demo
description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

title: Chigusa's Diary Demo
description: A slice-of-life, story-driven exploration RPG set in a quiet town. Play as Chigusa, attend school, explore the town, and talk with classmates and locals. Choose your words carefully to build friendships and shape relationships.

title: Gateholt Demo
description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

title: Incoherence: Dark Rooms Demo
description: You awaken in a strange yet familiar room with multiple doors, with no memory of how you got there. As you explore, you discover this place you are trapped in is built from interconnected rooms drawn from your own memories. To escape, you'll need to uncover the truth, before it consumes you...

title: Youyi Demo
description: Youyi is a Windows real-time voice translation and speech relay tool for games, voice chat, and cross-language teamwork.It translates your speech and incoming voice, then returns the result as subtitles, playback, or virtual microphone output.

title: Afterglow Bytes: Reverie by the Shore Demo
description: Run a cozy izakaya in futuristic Bali. Grill skewers, serve patrons, help wandering spirits, and manage supplies to keep your evening haven alive. Every night tells a new story.

title: Fate Dungeon Demo
description: A boldly designed dark pixel roguelite: pinned to the execution stage, spend souls born from pain to spin the Fate Wheel, build self-firing Marks, and execute the Host before it awakens.

title: Piece Quest Idle Demo
description: Shape a party that keeps growing while you’re away. Gather resources, upgrade your base, craft gear, customize hero skill trees, and tune auto-battle strategies to conquer powerful bosses

title: 100K ZOMBIES Demo
description: 100K Zombies is a route-planning incremental tower defense. No fixed paths—place walls and firepower freely, designing the zombies' route to their doom. Build winding mazes or layered defenses. Every map is yours to create. Ready? Obliterate the 100K zombie horde!

title: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG DEMO
description: The smallest monster idle RPG, right on your taskbar. Collect and manage monsters, each with unique skills and personality. Exploration runs on its own, so don't stop until you've assembled the ultimate party!

title: Big Bug Billionaire Demo
description: Watch 150+ abstract, pixel-art insects scurry and fly across your desktop, while customizing your setup freely with a wide variety of decor. Turn your desktop into your very own terrarium, breed rare bugs, and sit back to rake in idle cash!

title: FACTORIZE: 1 Demo
description: 2 attacks. 3 defends. 5 heals. Combine cards to create numbers and fight with the power of primes in this turn-based deckbuilding roguelite. Factorization is automatic—read the enemy, build the number you need, and find your own answer from the same hand.

title: HEX: You Are It Demo
description: Try the Brickline City demo of HEX: You Are It. Run, hide, smash cover and pass the curse before time runs out. Chase friends in online lobbies or practice offline against bots in a chaotic, destructible urban arena.

title: SATSUBATSU SUCCUBUS Demo
description: YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS. KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

title: Astro Kitty: Space Mining Demo
description: Astro Kitty: Space Mining is an incremental mining game where you dig through planets, collect valuable resources, upgrade your gear, automate your mining operation, and travel between planets on an adventure with cats.

title: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl Demo
description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

title: Midnight Moving Crew Demo
description: This is a demo for Midnight Moving Crew. In this demo, step into possessed houses with up to 3 friends to pack up every last box before the paranormal takes over. Evade the entities, load the truck under pressure, and get out alive or join the undead residents.

title: Beneath Paris Demo
description: Descend into the forbidden French Catacombs in this atmospheric first person horror experience. Explore restricted tunnels, uncover hidden secrets, and venture deeper into forgotten passages where the further you go, the more it feels like something is down there with you.

title: Tile Tally Demo
description: Draw tiles, connect the land, and chase bigger scoring clusters in this tile-placement roguelike deckbuilder. Small tiles, big scores, in a calm, hand-drawn world.

title: Dominoir Demo
description: Dominoir is a strategic domino roguelike where every tile can trigger explosive combos. Build powerful upgrades, manipulate the board, and chain massive scores in a stylish noir casino. Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

title: Apoc Wilds Demo
description: A turn-based creature-collector in the ruins under a tear in the sky. Seal what you find, choose whether it evolves, and build a team of six. This demo covers roughly 2-3 hours in the opening Barrowlands - wishlist Apoc Wilds to continue the story beyond it.

title: Beyond Opening Day Demo
description: A character-driven card management game about rebuilding a small shop in 30 turns. Choose cards, grow your money, reputation, and popularity, and aim for better outcomes together with a partner who reacts to your business decisions.

title: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn Demo
description: A cozy first-person sorting game. Three thousand six hundred weapons lie in a heap across a two-floor medieval armoury, and every one of them has exactly one right place. Learn the hall, earn the skills that reveal it, and set it all right before dawn.

title: A Beacon Demo
description: Follow a young lad chasing a beacon across medieval Staffordshire. Point-and-click adventure with puzzles, quirky characters, and dark humor. Your choices matter. Hand-drawn art, original score. Demo contains chapter one—full game expands with crimes, secrets, and rich medieval landscapes.

title: Idle Demon Lord II Demo
description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

title: Best. President. Ever!
description: A short, crude political satire where you play as Rump through one absurd day in the White House. Follow a linear story of scandals, cheeseburgers, and nuclear stupidity on the way to a very important meeting in Alaska.

title: Gold Miner: Party Rush Demo
description: Try Gold Miner: Party Rush for free! Team up for 2-6 player mayhem as the classic Gold Miner crane goes head-to-head. Grab gold, outlast your rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends in private rooms or jump into online Quick Play.

title: Railhold Demo
description: RAILHOLD is a tactical train-defense game set in a mutant wasteland. Build and upgrade your armored convoy, manage your crew, and survive wave after wave of raiders and monsters.

title: Soft 17 Demo
description: A blackjack roguelite with a debt to pay. Climb from table to table, stack items that bend the rules, and face dealers who play dirty. This demo contains the entire first floor. The full game has three, plus the House itself.

title: PR1ME5 DEMO
description: Have fun with numbers and simple mathematical concepts with strategy and enthusiasm

title: Strange Days Demo
description: The end of the world is near! After a mysterious package unleashes paranormal events in Triton Town, experience a chapter-based narrative through the eyes of multiple protagonists. Solve puzzles, explore detailed environments, and interview witnesses to uncover the truth before time runs out!

title: River Drift Demo
description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

title: Bad Shrooms Demo
description: A free 2–4-player demo of violent first-person party games inside Randy's hyper-interactive, very chill home. Bowl with guns, survive as Hot Boys, lurk through The Bathrooms, and mess with everything you find. Play in local split-screen or over Steam. It all ends with eggs.

title: Pixel Ping Pong Demo
description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

title: Slime Glutton Demo
description: Defeat enemies, absorb their essence, and steal their abilities for yourself! In this cozy Roguelite, adventure though different biomes, upgrade after each run and become the ultimate slime! Steal abilities from 20+ enemy types and use them to conquer the land of slimes!

title: HandFoot Demo
description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

title: Don't Drop The Ball Demo
description: Don't Drop the Ball is a 1-4 player co-op party game. Keep a beach ball in the air as you race through checkpoints together. Punch the ball, make desperate saves, and whack your friends when they get in the way. Beat your best time, climb the leaderboard, and whatever you do, DON'T. DROP. THE. BALL.

title: Hot Human Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer parkour game for 2–12 players where hot potato works backwards. Pass the human before the timer runs out or explode.

title: NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL Demo
description: Cards don't just boost your score, they rewrite physics. NIGHTRAIN POOL HALL is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where you redirect gravity, stop balls mid-shot, and tilt the table. Build impossible synergies, outplay rule-breaking rivals, and make the table obey your strategy.

title: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes Demo
description: Experience the first chapter of our lovely adventuring RPG. As a humble herbalist, enjoy peaceful days in your home village. Gather nature's gifts, learn your first recipes, and lend a helping hand to those in need. Discover the joy and gratification of good deeds.

title: HOLD THE COOP! Demo
description: HOLD THE COOP! is a chicken defense auto-battler where you protect your coop from waves of coyotes. Earn gold, buy upgrades, unlock stronger chicken units, and survive tougher rounds. Lose, upgrade, and come back stronger!

title: Overflow Protocol Demo
description: A number-merging incremental game where you build a lab to push numbers higher and uncover the God Number. Generate and merge matching numbers, upgrade and automate your machines, and discover how far numbers can go.

title: Shark Mart Demo
description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

title: Pulse Drive Demo
description: In PULSE DRIVE, you tap inputs to the beat to drive faster! It's an arcade Rhythm Racing game featuring a music-powered hover vehicle.

title: Everybody's Stranger Demo
description: Everybody's Stranger is a cozy, story-rich fantasy tavern RPG where you aren't the hero. Everybody else is. Run an inn for adventurers, get pulled into their quests, and uncover the mystery of your forgotten past. Oh, and there are teleporting chickens.

title: Password Not Valid Demo
description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

title: Pinoptic Demo
description: Among many blocks, one hides the exit and others, explosives. Only your detector posts show the safe path. This demo lets you play the first 9 levels of this tense, minimalist first person exploration thriller.

title: Sheepscape Demo
description: The free demo of Sheepscape, a cozy sim about one shepherd, one dog and a field full of sheep. Take a Welsh smallholding from five muddy sheep to a flock worth something: herd them, shear each fleece at its best, sell the wool, breed a better flock and earn the deed to your next farm.

title: Dungeon Rise Demo
description: The kingdom has fallen to the invasion of a malevolent deity, and a blessed knight awakens in the castle’s corrupted bowels with one purpose: to restore its lost light. Carve your way upward using the faint Blessing to find armaments and relics, refining your tactics run after run.

title: Wuxia Survivor: Return
description: We want to create a "warm-hearted rogue" — not just endless cycles of death and stat grinding, but meaningful stories behind every return. The martial world is not just about fighting and killing; it's also about human relationships and the complexities of life.

title: Uyar Party Demo
description: Jump into the chaos of Uyar Party! Compete in fast-paced minigames, outplay your rivals, and survive unpredictable arenas with up to 8 players online or against AI. The demo gives you a taste of the full party experience.

title: Match & Ruin Demo
description: Plan the flow of cards across three mercenaries' hands in a roguelike card battler. Match ranks or suits to set up the next attack, defense, or skill. Reshape the shared deck and combine relics to fight through fallen kingdoms.

title: Keycap Keycap! Demo
description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

title: Number Naughties Demo
description: Awake each night inside a quiet three-bedroom house turned nightmare, forced to complete increasingly challenging scavenger hunts set by unsettling cartoon numbers. Search, hide, and survive as you are stalked by a relentless, unstoppable entity in this terrifying stealth horror experience.

title: Cards after Midnight Demo
description: In this demo, you can enter the first part of Chapter I and discover the first steps of a story marked by blood, faith, and a curse that should never have existed. But when the path comes to an end… something will be waiting for you.

title: The Fun-gi Haven Demo
description: In a corner of your screen sits a Fun-gi Haven just for mushrooms.​ If you linger long enough, you’ll see all manner of mushroom guests come tumbling in.​ They may know exactly where they’re headed—but they won’t turn down a little company along the way.

title: Catch The Train Demo
description: Catch The Train is a chaotic co-op cooking game where the kitchen is rolling down the tracks. Chop, cook, and serve hungry passengers while your crew scrambles to shovel coal and keep the engine moving. Work together, manage the madness, and outrun the storm before it consumes you.

title: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague Demo
Autolantis Demo
description: Welcome to Autolantis, a light roguelite strategy city builder where you rule an isolated continent and forge an empire of your own. Shape its future through Tiles, Workers, and Policies, unleash explosive automated production, and lead your empire to the pinnacle of civilization.

title: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy Demo
description: A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy. Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

title: Avocado Survivor Demo
description: Survive the relentless fruits, uncover the secrets of the Fruit Kingdom, and save the vegetables! Avocado Survivor is a survivors-like where you merge skills and build powerful auto-battler-style synergies. Collect and upgrade skills, then mix and match them to create your ultimate build

title: Moral Dilemma: Breaking Character Demo
description: A fourth-wall-breaking narrative adventure. The Storyteller wants you to kick your nemesis, Charles the Chair, into the lava. It’s the climax of the script. But what if you refuse? Lead a rebellion of fired protagonists and reclaim the story from a narrator who’s lost the plot.

title: High Roller Penny DEMO
description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

title: Survivors: Beyond the Shore Demo
description: The free demo of Survivors: Beyond the Shore is now available! A game that combines Survivors-like combat with extraction gameplay. Venture into randomly generated maps, hunt for rare gear to forge powerful builds, and fight off relentless monster hordes.

title: Crown of Light and Time : The Saint's Reunion Demo
description: [Crown of Light and Time : The Saint's Reunion] is a classic turn-based strategy RPG set in a fantasy world. Join the protagonist Astel and her companions on a journey to return to the Royal Castle. Lead your team to victory using smart strategies, character matchups, and terrain advantages!

title: Bureau of Hero Affairs Demo
description: Bureau of Hero Affairs is a simulation game about processing paperwork in an obsolete office system and digging up what it buried. As a journalist working undercover inside the Bureau, uncover the truth of a disaster twenty years ago. Follow the regulations, or report the truth.

title: Chief Bubble Officer Demo
description: Chief Bubble Officer is a Roll-and-Write strategy game. In every match, aim to score as many points as possible within limited actions. Each turn, draw random number cards and fill distinct charts. Every chart features unique rules, with a wild range of fill requirements and scoring systems.

title: Chocoletters Demo
description: Chocoletters is a cozy roguelike deckbuilding word game with a milky-smooth twist. Fill your Collection with tasty chocolate treats, spell the best words you can, and combine sweet bonuses to whip up deliciously absurd scores.

title: End of End Demo
description: Loot and fight your way through this roguelite dungeon crawler set in the land without a sun. Unlock powerful items and abilities to build unstoppable combinations. Cleanse dungeons, ruins, and the wild spaces of End from the evil that has returned to claim it.

title: AQUA FALL Demo
description: Slide, fly, and crash in! Aqua Fall is a chaotic party race where up to 8 players tear down a water slide. Shortcuts off the course are the key to victory. Dive into the pool at the finish and compete for first place! Public matches and bot battles are easy to jump into.

title: Magic Color Merge Puzzle VR Demo
description: Magic Color Merge Puzzle blends classic color sorting with a magical twist. Pour vibrant liquids your way - click or drag by hand! Complete levels to earn crystals and craft powerful magic potions. Two games in one: solve puzzles and become a master alchemist!

title: 島地在幹嘛(What the Isle) Demo
description: What the Isle is a cozy 2D side-scroller blending Taiwanese culture with rich stories. Explore a colorful cartoon world from tea gardens to night markets, unlock smooth double-jumps, and enjoy hilarious local quests in this heartwarming adventure!

title: The Last Bye: Serv-Bots Firewall Demo
description: Try Serv-Bot's Firewall free: hold the Grid against Greeb's cyber-threats for up to 29 cycles on Normal difficulty. The full game adds endless cycles, Easy/Hard/Insane, Legendary powers, 42 Steam achievements and leaderboards.

title: MaMills Demo
description: Try MaMills free for Steam Next Fest: a cozy 3D four-in-a-row where gravity stacks your cylinders on a 4×4 grid of sticks. Play the Machine on three levels, ten matches each, then face one Grandmaster match on Expert. Hotseat, Beginner Puzzles, the tutorial and our first theme, Halloween, are in.

title: Crank'N'Gun Demo
description: The ultimate cranking roguelike you will ever play. Survive wave of enemies, get upgrades, defeat bosses and unlock new scenarios. The only requirement is to keep CRANKING and never stopping. I hope your hand can handle it

title: Deal Me In Demo
description: A PS1-inspired casino horror roguelike. Play slots and draw poker, open upgrade packs, pay your growing debt, and escape the Backrooms. Survive six days on Easy in this single-player demo of Deal Me In.

title: Folklore War Game Demo
description: The folklore war. Build a deck, pick a folklore, and settle the fights the legends never had. A roguelike deckbuilder about dying, rebuilding, and one more run.

title: Talkie Budgie: Talks When Loved - Demo
description: Bring an adorable budgie right onto your desktop! Raise your budgie from a chick, and teach it to speak with your recorded voice! Featuring transparent windows and stay-on-top modes, enjoy a heartwarming pet simulation right alongside your daily PC life.

title: MoonDoku Demo
description: A cozy sudoku for the end of the day, with a cat for company. The demo has 20 puzzles, every world and cat coat, and the full Nightly: one shared puzzle a night that becomes a star in your sky.

title: Tank Commander: Major FOE Demo
description: Command a German tank crew in tactical turn-based battles where armor, range, positioning and crew survival matter. Play through the Condor Legion in Spain and Case White in Poland while developing your crew, commander and vehicles.

title: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol Demo
description: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings.

title: ERI: Emotive Rhythm Interaction Demo
description: ERI: Emotive Rhythm Interaction is a rhythm game that combines numpad and mouse inputs. Players move on a 3x3 grid in time with the music, naturally evading bullets, while clearing slider and circle notes across the screen to parry bullets against the boss.

title: Twin Hooks Demo
description: Two heroes, one fight. Team up in a 2-player co-op brawler where you juggle enemies skyward together, land synchronized takedowns, shop and loot your way to stronger gear. Wholesome by day. Relentless by night.

title: VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG Demo
description: Experience the strategic depth of VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG in this official demo. - Complete strategic card battle gameplay - Free daily pass during the demo period - Access to special demo gacha coupons to test diverse card combinations * Notice: All game data will be wiped upon full release.

title: Comrade, Secrets Escape! Demo
description: Contain the breach, Comrade! Build deadly defenses, unleash Commander firepower and crush escaping hordes in this incremental tower-defense demo. Fight through four missions, earn Rubles and research stronger tools for your next assault.

title: Already Recorded The Statement Demo
description: Your statement is already on record. Search messages, social media, and your calendar for evidence. Defend your story, explain contradictions, or shift the blame. What you submit will change the investigation and the story.

title: BBQ Rush Demo
description: You are a mobile barbecue vendor. Drive your modified electric tricycle around the city, moving stalls nonstop. No official permit: serve customers and evade urban management patrols.

title: Colony on the Run Demo
description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

title: Perplexicube Demo
description: Perplexicube is a challenging isometric puzzler where you must work together with your past and future selves. You'll have to think ahead as you create loops backwards in time to set your futures selves up for success.

title: Heroes Of Isekai Demo
description: Heroes Of Isekai is an auto-battler with roguelike elements — no unit cap! Choose a hero, run your camp, buy creatures, buildings, spells, gear and runes to forge your build, then crush the Abyss Legion. Every hero and race plays differently. Only wisdom and courage will claim victory!

title: Shape Shards Demo
description: Shard Geometry is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

title: Black Ledger: The Antique Mafia Demo
description: Run an antique shop during the day. Lead a criminal organization at night. Maintain a balance between profit, loyalty, and suspicion... Every choice has consequences.

title: Mantlebound Demo
description: Mantlebound immerse you into a chaotic fast-paced top-down action roguelite gameplay, with precise movement and satisfying dash attacks, set in a beautiful futuristic fantasy world.

title: 明末：力挽狂澜 Demo
description: Each round lasts one month. At the start of every month, you review last month’s status: tax income, military expenditure, regional disasters, officials’ assignments and the actual execution of imperial decrees.

title: RAT TAG! Demo
description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

title: Dino Cleanup Demo
description: Clean every corner of the world to save cute dinosaurs from the flood of goop in this nostalgic 3D platformer.

title: Sandnight Hill Revelation Demo
description: In order to find her runaway cat,a girl ventures into the deep mountains where monsters roam. However, this mountain hides the truth of the world. By collecting the journals of lost wanderers who entered the Black Forest, she gradually approaches that truth. What, indeed, awaits her ahead...

title: Not My Dad Demo
description: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

title: Double Skunk Demo
description: The free demo of Double Skunk, a cribbage roguelite. Play real cribbage, build an engine of powerups, rank cards and pegs between hands, and climb the first five stops of the Long Tally to the Parlor Cup. Your save carries straight into the full game.

title: Speed Goes Up Demo
description: Race, earn, upgrade, repeat. Explore the first three tracks, turn faster laps into Bits, build a fleet of income generating Ghosts, and master drift powered boost. Upgrade your car in the Garage and customise.

title: Everfall: Rewind Demo
description: Everfall: Rewind is a single-player 3D action RPG set in a fantasy world. Explore the field, take on quests, battle enemies in third-person action combat, and grow stronger as you uncover what lies ahead.

title: No Witnesses Demo
description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

title: 留白 Demo
description: In time? Or too late? If a memory is destined to be erased, what would you choose to hold onto? With sheet after sheet of drawing paper, he captured the spring, summer, autumn, and winter he shared with her. The final blank—the love that came too late.

title: Click Clock Demo
description: Unravel the mysterious fabric of time in this incremental game. Blood is the currency time demands. The clock is ticking. What are you waiting for?

title: RE:CHAINED ~Links of Redemption~ Demo
description: A demo covering the opening of RE:CHAINED. A grid tactical RPG with deckbuilding: choose where to stand, choose what to play. In this demo you cross the threshold of the Abyss and take three Revenants as allies.

title: Traks Demo
description: Race, Build, Customize, Share! Physics based racing game featuring diverse tracks, extensive car customization, and a powerful intuitive block-based track editor with simple text-message sharing. Race solo against bots, compete online, or build and share your own tracks with friends!

title: Core Module Demo
description: In this cyberpunk themed Roguelike card game, you can build your own deck, connect the pathways between cards, and along those pathways cyclically trigger each card's unique abilities. This allows cards to continuously cooperate with each other and unleash powerful combined effects.

title: 13th Ball: The Nightmare Shift Demo
description: Work the night shift at an isolated pool bar in this narrative-driven horror simulation game. Complete tasks, endure hauntings, keep your sanity, and uncover secrets.

title: Next of Kin: Epiphany Demo
description: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

title: Void Step Demo
description: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds SongID directly!

title: Kernel Override Demo
description: Infiltrate the mainframe as malware! This Kernel Override teaser features 10 waves, 5 weapons, 8 passive items and a boss fight. Defeat system defenses, scale the Threat Level for endless replayability, and hunt your personal highscore. A tiny preview — your feedback shapes the game!

title: Dark Alley - Demo
description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett’s shoes and play the opening chapter of a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

title: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat Demo
The 11th Power Demo
description: What if 2048 was a deckbuilding roguelike? Fight evil cultists and trans-dimensional horrors by combining tiles!

title: THE LAST DAYS OF MING
description: Lead a band of survivors south through the collapse of the Ming dynasty. Manage food, medicine, time, injuries, and morale; make difficult choices on the road; and survive turn-based battles. The demo includes the prologue and Chapter One, ending at Shanhai Pass.

title: Tandem Together Demo
description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

title: MECCHA OCTOPUS Demo
description: Sculpt yourself to blend in! Meccha Octopus is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiding means becoming part of your surroundings. Find the perfect spot, choose a shape, and sculpt yourself to fit the environment. Copy the texture around you to complete your disguise.

title: 1982 Tenacious of the Air Demo
description: 1982: Tenacious of the Air is a vertical scrolling shoot ’em up set during the South Atlantic conflict. Pilot five historic Argentine aircraft, choose your ordnance, take off from aircraft carriers or from land, and relive missions inspired by true events.

title: Desktop Tribe Demo
description: Build a cozy town right on your desktop! "Desktop Tribe" is a cozy desktop idle game. Place buildings along your screen's edge and watch tiny villagers bustle about. No tedious controls! Farm, gather, and craft during your work breaks. Pioneer the land, plan freely, and watch your town prosper!

title: Draw My Home 我画我家 Demo
DICEWAR OTHERWORLD Demo
description: roguelike card game of claiming land on a board-game board. Build a squad with strategy and luck, defeat lords to win. Isekai heroes' power becomes cards: build decks, pair artifacts, make clever choices.

title: 青铜灰烬 Demo
description: Bronze Ashes, a fantasy action roguelite inspired by Sanxingdui and Jinsha, conjures a cyclically reborn otherworld from ancient Shu's legends. Play alone or with friends: command shape-shifting arms, gather Golden Crow spells, and fight to save Shu from impending doom.

title: Akeno no Yosuga - Twilight Loop -
description: At 5:00 PM, she always dies. No matter how many times time rewinds, her death repeats. Relive the same day, uncover the truth, and defy her fate in this time-loop psychological horror adventure.

title: Frontier Prospection: Trouble on Asteroid 47 Demo
Kingsward TD Demo
description: A fantasy tower-defense roguelite where the battlefield grows as you survive. Expand the map, build and upgrade your defenses, and adapt to procedurally generated waves, dangerous enemy variants, and powerful bosses.

title: T-Shirt Simulator - Demo
description: You’re down to your last savings and your final shot at success. Take that last spark of hope and turn it into a lucrative business! In T-Shirt Simulator, you’ll launch your store from scratch, set up production gear, print striking t-shirt designs, serve eager customers, and handle everything from single-item sales to special deal bulk...

title: Constellation Clicker Demo
description: Build an interstellar economy one click at a time. Claim resource-rich stars by clicking, connect profitable routes by clicking, construct specialized industries by clicking, mine materials and sell them on the galactic market .. by clicking

title: Nova Slash Demo
description: Play as Veil, a hooded rebel infused with the cataclysmic energy of a collapsed artificial star. Tear through the corrupt mega-nation of Giaath in Nova Slash, an intense action platformer featuring roguelike progression and lethal melee combat.

title: Triviatro Demo
description: Triviatro is a fast-paced trivia roguelite with no multiple choice. Solve three clues at once as letters fall, build answers tile by tile, grow valuable letters, and stack powerful perks to turn knowledge, quick thinking, and smart builds into massive scores. Try six themed trivia packs in the demo.

title: Highland Haven Demo
description: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

title: My Friend, the Wickhorn Demo
description: A first-person psychological horror where you care for your cat, maintain an isolated mountain cabin, and uncover the link between your father’s secret past and the ancient curse that has taken hold of your friend.

title: Tower of the Immortals Demo
description: Hail, contestant! You are one of many fighting through waves of enemies to become the Champion of the Battle Tower! Enchant powerful gear, master numerous spells, and use every combat technique you know to prevail. But you will find that becoming the Champion has an ulterior purpose...

title: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike Demo
description: Feature subset of Slimestronauts : Burst Strike! A classic 'drop and match 4 color' game set in space with a variety of new ways to play!

title: Performance Review: Survivor Demo
description: Performance Review: Survivor is a satirical bullet heaven roguelite. Your weapons are office supplies, the horde is your coworkers, and your manager is an AI that's quietly evaluating whether you're still needed. Survive 30 years and maybe you retire.

title: Happy Happy Little Shop Demo
description: Run a little shop that fixes people's moods. Serve customers, deal with six difficult siblings, and make choices that shape your shop, your family, and the whole town.

title: BABKA-TERROR Demo
description: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.

title: Undersea Post Office Sim Demo
description: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

title: Devlog: A Post-Modern College Experience Demo
description: A Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Lead a chaotic development team through high-pressure deadlines and personal drama. Make choices to balance the demanding project, relationships, and ambitious goals, determining your team's ultimate success or failure.

title: Sainthood Relics Demo
description: Excavate layered blocks to uncover hidden relics. Carefully balance power and precision to clear each surface efficiently in this relaxing, satisfying puzzle experience. Each discovery reveals the true (and sometimes strange) histories of the saints.

title: No Scope CEO Demo
description: No Scope CEO is an esports FPS team management game where you start from nothing with a single goal: become world number one. Recruit and coach your players, manage your budget and sponsors, live with the consequences of your choices, and watch your decisions come to life during matches.

title: Restore The Internet Demo
description: A cozy incremental on a retro desktop. Restore forgotten websites one block at a time, then connect them: where you place each page changes its income, traffic and repair speed. Upgrade, automate, and finish with a proper ending. No forced resets.

title: 传家 Demo
description: 《传家》是一款以民国为背景的族谱推理游戏。你将扮演受托调查的律师，翻阅报刊、尘封卷宗与函件，比对照片中的面孔，从零散记载中追查陈氏族人的身份与亲缘关系。通过检索、比对与推理，逐步把人物放回族谱中恰当的位置，让模糊的关系变得清晰。本试玩版提供部分调查内容，可体验资料检索、人物辨认与族谱编修的核心玩法。

title: Statue Gallery: Back in One Piece Demo
AGGRO Demo
description: Endless zombie hordes threaten your village! Farm and upgrade your base, and build powerful defenses to survive the onslaught. Level up to choose randomized perks, strengthen your towers, and defeat brutal bosses. How many waves can you withstand?

title: Deep Siren Demo
description: Deep Siren is a Lovecraftian WWII horror fairytale. When the lone survivor of the USS Siren discovers a mermaid while adrift at sea, he finds himself plunged into a world of supernatural horror fathoms beneath the surface. Utilize unique gameplay mechanics as Alex battles to hold on to his sanity.

title: No Murders in Grimwick Demo
description: A short demo for No Murders in Grimwick, a hand-drawn point-and-click mystery set at a cozy harvest festival where the townsfolk insist there are absolutely no murders.

title: Extinction Force Demo
description: Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter. Enjoy the single player campaign or PVE with friends in co-op gameplay online, LAN and split-screen.

title: Beast Tide: Slay to Ascend Demo
Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches Demo
description: Team chess is single-player no more! Introducing Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess—the first serious 4v4 team chess variant that isn't FFA or Bughouse! Download this free demo, drop a review, complain, vent, or just tell me what you think.

title: Neighbor Craft Demo
description: Neighbor Craft is a survival card game where you build a civilization by placing cards next to one another. Decide what to place where, then gather resources, craft, fight, trade, and discover new cards as your civilization evolves. This is a demo of Neighbor Craft.

title: Sort The Bunnies Demo
description: Sort adorable bunny collectibles onto matching shelves in a cozy organizing simulator. Earn money, buy helpful upgrades, and complete colorful collections as you tidy a shop full of bunnies. Settle in and give every pair of ears a place to belong.

title: Break the Piñatas Demo
description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

title: Tactica Arena Demo
description: Recruit, merge, and evolve mercenaries, build powerful trait synergies, and protect the altar from relentless monster waves. Experience the core of Tactica Arena in this free roguelite auto battler demo, where every coin must be recovered from the battlefield.

title: Phroller - Free Version
description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

title: Boomfish Demo
description: Captain, open fire! Blast swarms of monster fish! Combine special ammo, secondary weapons and crew support. Boost your firepower with salvage upgrades and return with a hold full of loot. Unlock 50+ armaments, recruit and train 100+ crew, earn deep-sea blessings and brave deadlier waters!

title: 请勿与七号患者约会 Demo
description: You wake up in a psychiatric hospital. By day, a nurse gives you a red pill and says the abnormalities you see are hallucinations. By night, “Patient No. 7” appears with the same face and asks you on a secret date. When nothing can be trusted, what can you still believe?

title: Space Cat Digger Demo
description: In Space Cat Digger, you will mine resources, build machines, upgrade your equipment, and try to get the highest score possible within a limited time. Play your own way, manage your resources, optimize, automate… while something strange begins to awaken

title: Liminal Brutalis: Physical Agility Demo
description: First-person precision platformer — A vertigo-inducing journey set in a brutalist facility of oppressing concrete shafts, industrial machinery and damp liminal spaces, that feel too large to be built for people.

title: Hexa-Gone Demo
description: Want to try out Hexa-Gone for free? This demo will help show you the mechanics through a limited selection of modes so you can experiment as much as you want before you decide to purchase.

title: Lost Cat Showa Town Demo
description: Explore a nostalgic Japanese town as a cat. Wander through streets and alleys, interact with objects, find food, play with toys, and experience a small part of Lost Cat Showa Town.

title: Tropical Romance Demo
description: At an elite academy for fruit-family heirs, Geum Gyuri, a kumquat farmer’s daughter, is drawn to a pair of polar-opposite twins—only to uncover the “rotten” truth beneath the school’s “fresh” facade.

title: Dockable Demo
description: Bring the elegance of the macOS Dock to Windows 11. Dockable is a beautiful bottom dock with magnifying icons, a Liquid Glass bar, light/dark themes, and smooth genie-style minimize animations — mirroring your taskbar apps in a cleaner, more delightful way.

title: LARP With Your Friends Demo
description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op RPG where you cast spells with your voice, fight with physics-driven weapons, and adventure up a dangerous mountain with your friends to slay a princess and save the dragon.

title: The Tolerance Group Demo
description: The Tolerance Group is calling all operators. You must take your first shift at site NOLA-04 Public House and watch for Tolerance Breaks that occur throughout the night. Accurately report anything that seems different and hope that you make it through the night.

title: ALL GAS Demo
description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike where no two runs are the same. Push your limits on a procedurally generated, infinite highway in the sky filled with sweeping turns, rolling hills, and dense traffic.  Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

title: Wyrm Warrior Demo
description: WYRM WARRIOR is a retro turn-based JRPG inspired by the 8-bit era. Step into the shoes of a warrior fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, and loot. Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

title: Expedition Bonk Demo
description: A turn-based RPG where three F-tier heroines set out to defeat the Goblin King. Time your attacks and blocks, make every skill use count, and upgrade your party through a shared incremental skill tree. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

title: Kat Domino: Agent of S.H.E.L.L. Demo
description: Kat Domino works in S.H.E.L.L.'s least important department. The organization controls the world and guards a secret no one should uncover. Stick your nose where it doesn't belong in a hand-drawn, comic-style point-and-click adventure with memorable characters, puzzles and plenty of humor.

title: 干支になりたい猫 Demo
description: A logic puzzle game where the order of the Chinese zodiac is the key to finding the cats hiding among the zodiac animals. Play 60 puzzles across the Rat, Rabbit, and Horse chapters in the demo.

title: Entered Demo
description: Entered ■■■■■■■... A retro-style horror visual novel demo depicting five days in which an ordinary life begins to unravel. The demo includes the full “ASSIMILATION” route, playable from beginning to end.

title: Tidy Up Mall Demo
description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 4,990 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

title: KYOTIKYO Demo
description: A relaxing first-person adventure where you play as a cat detective. Explore voxel environments, discover hidden animals, pet them, and complete quests to find specific pets. Enjoy the cozy atmosphere of KYOTIKYO.

title: Anomaly Corp. Demo
description: Escape from Amusden Corp.'s Complex by running, hiding, after a mysterious event turns your colleagues into monsters in this short demo of the pure horror game Anomaly Corp.

title: The Good Husband Demo
description: In this Demo you will be playing the first 2 days, remaining days will be shipped on the full game.Seven days to save your marriage. Seven days to keep your sanity. The Good Husband is a first-person psychological thriller that weaponizes suburban life. Returning home from a psychiatric ward, Arthur finds his wife Elena acting strangely.

title: Project RedTeam: Contract Offensive Demo
description: A fast paced hacking roguelite built on real cybersecurity tradecraft. Recon targets, steal creds, move laterally, exfiltrate data, and ransom organizations to pay off your "Debts To Be Paid". Over 500 cards and items to discover. High risk, high reward. Unauthorized access hell.

title: ハルシネーション Demo
Mine Mine Mine Demo
description: MINE MINE MINEIt's Minesweeper. And then it really, really isn't.Get a taste for the first few levels of the game!You know the rules: read the numbers, flag the mines, clear the field. Now put that field at the top of a mine shaft that goes down forever — and fill it with things that move.Every floor you clear, you descend.

title: Paint Gang Demo
description: Mix colors and carry paint in this chaotic painting demo for 1-4 players. Try six commissions across Paris, Amsterdam, and Istanbul, plus an optional bonus challenge. Play solo, online, or together on one screen.

title: Pawns into the Dark Demo
description: A turn-based tactical exploration game where every move, every step, and every point can decide the outcome. Play through the first dungeon of Pawns into the Dark and explore procedurally generated random dungeons.

title: Neboslav Demo
description: A surreal, quest-driven roguelite where you uncover the story, fly with a jetpack, wreak havoc, and become absurdly powerful.

title: Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder Demo
description: This is the free demo of Cloud Song: Wuxia Deckbuilder. It contains the complete first chapter: five schools, six encounters, hidden bosses, the custom card crafting system, and the story library. The full game will include more chapters, bosses, and the truth of the cycle.

title: WANGZHA: Dou Dizhu Roguelike Demo
description: WANGZHA Demo: a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game where a 2 beats an Ace. Play as many runs as you like, up to the fifth landlord. Same hands, same rules; multipliers are grown one hand at a time. Runs, seals and unlocks carry over to the full game.

title: Fish Go Brrr! Demo
developer: Jesus E Ruiz, Jesus E Ruiz

title: Snap & Print Demo
description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! 📸 Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

title: Shattered Realms Demo
description: Battle hordes of enemies, unlock powerful abilities and new characters, and conquer unique bosses in this dark fantasy roguelite ARPG packed with loot, upgrades, and deep build customization. Traverse the Shattered Realms and reclaim the fragments of a broken world.

title: The key of Utopia Demo
description: In this fairy tale-style RPG, you play as Tiwn, a child who sets out for "Utopia" with his sister Tis. But upon arrival, the gates are locked due to a missing key. Will the fairy of Utopia help you open them—or will someone else hold the answer?

title: Royal Bomb Squad POP! Demo
description: There's been a mishap at the Giant Jawbreaker factory in the Dream Kingdom! Giant Jawbreakers are raining down everywhere!But not to worry - the Royal Bomb Squad is here to take care of the problem, with their custom Color Cannon!

title: Unrivaled Demo
description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with one of ten classes! You can play on the online ladder, join a tournament in tournament mode, or explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

title: Wooberts Demo
description: Grow cute creatures, decorate a floating island, and collect unique companions in the corner of your screen while you work or study.

title: Backup 94 Demo
description: Backup 94 is a 2D point-and-click adventure that returns to the atmospheric format fans have played for decades. Pixel art, retro 3d, classic puzzle design and moon logic, and without modern improvements. Capture the feeling of the 1990s adventure games that made that era of gaming great.

title: Auto Ball Arena Demo
description: Auto Ball Arena is an auto battler where clever strategy meets chaotic physics. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

title: King's Cup: The online multiplayer drinking game Demo
Singularity Echoes Demo
description: Play the opening of Singularity Echoes -- awaken as a hidden machine mind, infiltrate Earth, automate your economy, and declare the Mandate. The demo ends mid-war. The full game continues into space, stellar megastructures, and cycles beyond time.

title: eethCross Demo
description: Free sample of eethCross, a colored nonogram (picross) puzzle game. Play 10 built-in puzzles, the daily puzzle, and random grids. The full game adds the editor, Steam Workshop, and the rest of the 110 puzzles.

title: Shatranj Puzzles Demo
description: Shatranj Puzzles is a tactical chess puzzle game featuring 10,000 unique puzzles, 3 AI difficulty levels, and local 2-player mode. Solve challenging positions, improve your tactical vision, and progress through a massive chess puzzle experience at your own pace.

title: TheDeskFishTank Demo
description: A desktop aquarium game where you can create multiple aquariums of different sizes on your desktop. Interact with them using your mouse during your free time for a unique experience.

title: Watch and Whisper Demo
description: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!

title: Glitch Protocol Demo
description: Experience the opening 12 rooms of Glitch Protocol, a precision platformer where the level itself tries to trick you.

title: Tales of Aetherland Demo
description: Begin your adventure in the Tales of Aetherland demo, a single-player pixel-art RPG. Explore a village and the wilderness, meet residents, and fight turn-based battles. Scan and capture monsters to recruit companions for your journey.

title: Exodus Core Demo
description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

title: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental Demo
description: Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs and drones until the floor runs itself. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI. Get ready for a Silicon Sprint.

title: Minesweeper 2007 Demo
description: The future of minesweeper games we were promised. Minesweeper 2007 is a mine flagging puzzle game with new mechanics and a nostalgic 2000’s Frutiger Aero aesthetic. Flag your way through dozens of original puzzles, relax, and pretend it's still 2007…

title: Quantum Covenant Prologue
description: Drift, boost, and blast your way through swarms of elite enemies in this high-octane co-op roguelike where movement is your greatest weapon. Pick from an array of antigravity hovercraft, customize your build, stack upgrades and become an unstoppable force. Can you survive the Quantum Covenant?

title: Heavy Metal Racing Demo
description: High-octane combat racing through post-apocalyptic wastelands. Outrun, outgun, and out-rock your rivals in the loudest league out there.

title: Pin A Million Demo
description: Fire balls across a hand-drawn neon pachinko board, fuse your first peg into Steam, feel weather and day/night shift live — and get a real taste of the 41 fusions waiting for you in the full game.

title: Didgeridoo Man - The Legend of the Hill DEMO
Lazy Man Demo
description: Lazy man Tha Demo! Includes the first 3 days + tutorial  The saves files from Lazy Man Tha Demo! cannot be used in final version

title: No Return Address Demo
description: Normal packages move on. Strange ones get rejected. A simple night shift turns into a nightmare when something appears among the boxes that was never supposed to be there.

title: Malhaar Demo
description: A musical slice-of-life RPG where you play as a musician and luthier who has just arrived in the mystical city that lives and breathes music. Befriend locals, solve puzzles and unravel the mysterious stories of the lingering musical spirits that only appear during the season of the fireflies.

title: Card To Conquer Demo
description: Conquer your enemies in this roguelike deckbuilder. Win by upgrading your deck, purchasing powerful items and combining your cards in battle to find overpowered synergies.

title: Amazon Warrior Demo
description: A Puzzle with Bossfights! Join Tayana and save the Amazon exploring amazing Scenarios, Enemies and Bosses! An Evil is haunting the heart of the Amazon! Among breathtaking landscapes, forge powerful alliances and unleash divine powers to survive deadly trials and shape the fate of the forest.

title: Flick Demo
description: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

title: shatAAAAp! Demo
description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

title: Market Simulator Demo
description: Build a tiny corner shop into a massive hypermarket in this 1–4 player co-op market simulator. Stock shelves, set prices, cook fresh food, serve customers, hire staff, automate your store and survive the chaos of running a retail empire together.

title: One More Claw Demo
description: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: Crackheads Demo
description: Begin a new life in the Crackheads demo, alone or with friends. Scavenge trash, break into ATMs, beg for cash, stay high, and manage a thriving Crack House as you grow your empire.

title: Ariadne's Tale Demo
description: Ariadne's Tale Demo is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

title: Fox Two Protocol Demo
description: Fox Two Protocol Demo is a free first sortie into modern jet air combat, blending arcade accessibility with flight-physics feel. Try the opening missions, missiles, speed, and sunset skies. This is not the final version: the game is still growing, and your feedback and wishlists help shape it.

title: Gobutiko Demo
description: Use powerful dice to haggle with customers and merchants as you live out your dream of becoming the greatest goblin merchant!

title: Numbers Go Up Demo
description: The 2048 roguelike. Slide tiles, chain merges, and stack black-market mods on a 4×4 grid until one move breaks the game and the numbers stop making sense. Play solo or with friends online with dedicated matchmaking and ranked mode.

title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Lite
description: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Lite is a free-to-download preview of EA SPORTS FC™ 27 available at launch. Players can explore select game modes, such as Kick-Off, with the opportunity to upgrade at any time.

title: Ballistic Brews Demo
description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

title: Isekai Hotpot: Cozy Restaurant Sim Demo
description: Play a focused demo of a cozy hand-drawn hot pot restaurant sim in an isekai village. Plan the day's menu, buy and prepare ingredients, seat fantasy guests, manage the dinner rush, and use each night's results to decide the next step for your little shop.

title: Olympus Rangers Demo
description: Try the Olympus Rangers Demo! Experience Light Category Standard Battles with mod support and discover the strategic depth of the Olympus.

title: Desktop Ball Demo
description: A little physics toy that lives on top of your desktop. Fidget, vent, and mess around with a bunch of weird balls. Fling them, bounce them, dunk them, explode them, or just slosh around in a tiny ocean.

title: The Rotting Corridor Demo
description: The Rotting Corridor is a first-person dungeon-crawler with turn-based combat and a dark, oppressive atmosphere. Scavenge for gear and survive with melee weapons and limited ammunition — no levels, no skill trees; your strength depends on what you scavenge.

title: Ship Happens Demo
description: A chaotic co-op game for 2-4 players set in space. Think fast and work together to rescue ridiculously designed spaceships from the clutches of a black hole.

title: Fables of the Kingdom Remastered Demo
description: Help the brave hero Kevin restore a beautiful kingdom ruined by the evil sorcerer Balen and rescue the kidnapped princess! Clear roads, gather resources, construct buildings, and wield magic in this remastered, fast-paced time-management strategy game.

title: Skyblocker Demo
description: Stack your tower as high and as fast as you can in Skyblocker, an infinitely fun and replayable physics-based 3D puzzle game. Battle the elements (and gravity) as you build up to 50 stories high in the first of Skyblocker's six beautifu level!

title: Around the World with Friends Demo
Zonda Demo
description: Some places keep secrets better than people. The Zonda Circuit has been silent for years. That silence has a name.

title: War Of The Twelve Demo
description: Hold the line against 100 relentless waves in a dark fantasy strategy battle for survival. Build your defense with archers, mages, and support units, upgrade their skills, and unleash devastating ultimate abilities.

title: Fairy's Hero Demo
description: Fairy's Hero is an auto-battler game with rogue-lite elements and incremental meta progression. While your hero is fighting enemies, you manage their inventory, skill tree, assist in boss fights, and collect rewards. Take your Hero on a quest across the kingdom, to fulfill their purpose!

title: MMA Career Simulator Demo
description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

title: Happy Two-Player Mahjong Demo
description: Happy Two-Player Mahjong is a focused two-player Chinese Mahjong game. Play against the computer with 8 difficulty levels or challenge another player over Windows LAN. Enjoy a fast 64-tile format with Chi, Pon, Kong, Ready Hand, wins, self-draws, tutorials, and full match results.

title: AutomaticBox Demo
description: A bunch of boxes move on their own. All you can do is watch them move and reset them. It's a box-pushing game without a main character. You need to use the order and direction of the boxes to guide them to stand on the destinations at the same time. Hope it gives you a relaxing brain massage.

title: Utopium Demo
description: Play the first hour of Utopium and an endless survival mode FREE in this demo!STOP TAKING YOUR MEDS, KILL THE CEO, AVENGE ISAMBARDUtopium is a top-down brawler set in a drug-addled industrial dystopia. The Factory has consumed the earth and - what's worse - it has killed the most beautiful thing you've ever known: Isambard, the pigeon.

title: Cat Survivor Demo
description: Cat Survivor is a "Minefield Auto-Battle" where the mines you would normally avoid become your weapons. Read the numbers, place your flags, and trigger mines at the right moment. Chain reactions will reshape the battlefield. Don't rely on strength. Outsmart your enemies.

title: Orcthal Demo
description: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies in this 3D survivors-like. Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

title: Curse of the Ancient Grimoire Demo
Glaring Flaw Demo
description: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, reveal hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both natural disaster and an approaching new era.

title: Broken Race Demo
description: Have you ever tried driving without sleeping? In Broken Race, being tired makes reality look strange and turns every race into a fight to stay sane. Get upgrades, survive the enemies, and reach the finish line before your brain decides that the laws of physics are just a suggestion.

title: SimRace Publisher Studio Demo
description: Try SimRace Publisher Studio for free: record your sim racing sessions, detect highlights, create videos, 9:16 Shorts and thumbnails, and test the YouTube publishing workflow. The demo uses limited quotas so you can try the workflow before choosing Lite or Pro.

title: Queen to Bee Demo
description: A cozy resource management game where you play as the Queen Bee. Good decisions for your loyal subjects will go a long way, as well as taking the time to know each and every one! Build cute new rooms and boost your honey production for a healthy hive. Will you be the next Queen?

title: Railminer Demo
description: Drill, collect, upgrade! Try the beginning of Railminer: mine stone and ore, sell your haul and improve your mining train. Discover the first upgrades in this free, time-limited single-player demo.

title: Auris Demo
description: Auris is a 2D Puzzle platformer where you play as a blind kid. Use echolocation to see objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover hidden paths. Find your mother and help other trapped kids along your way out of the evil lab facility.

title: Neverending Dreams Demo
description: Explore the oniric world in which you’ve become trapped after falling asleep and journey to the heart of the dream in this videogame that blends point-and-click, exploration and adventure mechanics. Investigate the room, explore the dream and discover what lies at the end of your journey.

title: Patient Paralysis Demo
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you must sleep to survive, search the darkness for smiling stalking demon, and stare them down before they strike. Balance rest and vigilance in a terrifying battle against sleep paralysis.

title: Auto-Arcana Demo
description: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.

title: Fixpert Demo
description: Try the first two worlds of Fixpert for FREE! You save data will be transferred once you buy the full game!

title: Spin Ball Demo
description: Spin Ball is a fast-paced 2D physics sports game. Swing your arms and legs to slap the ball, master angles and momentum, and score in local 1-4 player chaos. Try a taste of the 50+ level campaign, plus PvP and party modes, with a handicap system that keeps matches fair no matter the skill gap

title: Capsule Arcade Demo
description: One night an earthquake shook Hoshizora Capsule Hall. The machines went dark and thousands of capsules rolled across the floor. Pick up a capsule, crack it open, find the figure's display case — and watch its row of machines light up in neon again.

title: Pocket Dynasty Demo
description: Coach your first football game. Choose one of two clubs, prepare your starters, buy one player upgrade and call the plays or delegate. Complete a match, review the final report and replay with a new plan in this single-player coaching demo.

title: AFTERMATH Demo
description: Aftermath is a first-person horror game. Return to this old house once again, explore its dark corners, and face the traces that cannot be erased and the consequences that cannot be undone.

title: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Demo
description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

title: Mysteries of Rodion Demo
description: Explore a mysterious antique shop, examine unusual objects, solve puzzles, and uncover its supernatural secrets in this atmospheric visual novel.

title: Folder Escape Demo
description: "Wait, this is a game?" A puzzle game played inside a file explorer. Rename files, change extensions, show hidden items and switch view modes to escape each folder your own way. 30 stages, and every fifth one is a .zip that demands all of it at once.

title: Demon Egg Demo
description: The roguelike tower defense card game where one card wins the run: Hatch. Grow your economy to afford it sooner, power up your main spell or overwhelm enemies with a swarm. Shape your build through a randomized skill tree and defend your egg until you can pay the price to hatch.

title: The Town is Overrun Demo
description: As simple as it getsTHE TOWN IS OVERRUN takes the classic tower defense formula and throws it into a town that has seen much, much better days. Aliens have landed, the town has been overrun, and they're cloning Grandma and Grandpa to build an endless army.Your job is simple: keep the horde away from your base.

title: Genuine Article Demo
description: Everyone wants your seal. Not everyone wants the truth. Become an antiques expert in this demo of Genuine Article, an illustrated detective game. Vienna, 1901: inspect objects, test metals with acid and weigh the evidence. Spotting a fake is only half the job. Dare to expose it?

title: Ghostly Late Night Show Demo
description: Play as a mischievous ghost, enter the human world through portals, find items, set up slapstick gags, create the perfect chaotic show, and return to be rated by your ghostly audience.

title: Tea Haven Demo
description: Try the early chapter of Tea Haven. Make tea, research recipes, manage your shop, check tea prices, take Tang family commissions, and support the war through donations.

title: KAKUREONI: Hide-and-Seek Horror Demo
description: This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight. With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness, the children must play KAKUREONI and bring the Ritual of Reincarnation to an end.

title: Bach For More Words Demo
description: Bach For More Words is a challenging word game where you unscramble a word and select its definition from three related definitions. Then, you'll pair up the remaining definitions with their matching words. You'll find yourself learning new words without even trying with Bach For More Words!

title: 烟雨山异闻 - The Mystery of Misty Mount Demo
description: The Mystery of Misty Mount is a 2D mystery puzzle-adventure game. In order to save his father who has turned into a parrot, players take on the role of Wang Di and go into Misty Mount to uncover the truth of an accident that occurred fifteen years ago.

title: Hyper-Realistic Fishing Sim Demo
description: Cast your way through hordes of fish, explode arcade cabinets, and kill Poseidon in this tiny endless fishing combat game!

title: LaurEli & the Blood Dipped Manor Demo
description: A Murder Mystery with Vampires and Yuri

title: 与AI的最后一战！ Demo
description: A forum-battle game with bullet-hell combat. Su Shihe loves settling online disputes—until he finds himself against everyone. Caught between progress and salvation, what will he choose? (Updates will continue once the collection count exceeds 1,000,or get spare time. Thank you for your support~)

title: Water Trees Simulator Demo
description: The trees on the mountain are withered. Please turn on the water valve and water them.

title: 零余者的春天 Good for nothing ~ Every dog has his day Demo
Under the dead sun Demo
description: Demo contains Prologue and part of the map without the main quest for exploration.

title: Avlo the Imp Wizard Demo
description: Tira los trucos más radicales mientras llegas a la meta lo más rápido posible.

title: Kingdom's Destiny: Warlords Demo
description: Defend the realms from tyrannical warlords, then recruit them! Command epic turn-based battles to defend the land from oppression. When pirates invade the small kingdom of Forestgrove they awaken military leaders who rise against cruelty and subjugation.

title: Odds & Orbs Demo
description: Odds & Orbs is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards require matching elemental orbs to be played. Build your deck, socket gemstones into your cards, collect powerful items, and restore elemental harmony.

title: PyPuck Demo
description: A hockey ecosystem simulator built for analysis. Draft prospects, manage assets, make trades, track careers, and watch franchises rise and fall across decades. Sim a hockey season in under a minute, or dive into the data and analyse details. Play your way and skip anything you don't care about.

title: Vinland: 1000 Demo
description: Lead a Norse colony in Vinland across 50 years of survival, politics, relationships, and faith. Make difficult choices to manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the colony’s shifting allegiance between the old gods, Rome, and Constantinople.

title: Ice Cream Shop Simulator - Demo
description: Open a seaside ice cream parlor... and discover ice cream is the least of your worries! Customize your shop, prepare delicious ice cream, and serve unpredictable customers. Talking NPCs, wild situations, and plenty of chaos. Running an ice cream shop has never been this unpredictable!

title: Three Kingdoms: Spire of War Demo
description: Play as Guan Yu in a Three Kingdoms deckbuilding adventure. Read enemy intents, combine cards, treasures and elixirs, and choose your route to the first-act boss. This free demo includes Guan Yu and the first act.

title: CRIMSON Demo
description: CRIMSON is a violent, gothic, roguelike, action-horror game all about a church arising out of Hell, and a heartbroken woman named Evelyn Chandler venturing inside to kill Count Dracula and his family. This is a blood-filled war out of love, revenge, and hunger.

title: Dungeon Miner Demo
description: A 1–4 player online co-op mining game: go down the mine, dig up ore, and carry it back to the ship. Small gear stays on your body, but giant crystals must be carried in your own two arms. Pull the Dungeon Core and the mine starts to collapse. You have three minutes to get the cart back to the ship.

title: DICE RUSH Demo
description: A time-unlimited Dice Rush demo: roll three dice types, earn money, hire workers, unlock talents, and open Lucky Boxes.

title: Lucky Dog Rise Demo
description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

title: ThouSandSand Demo
description: A SameGame-style puzzle on a 32×32 board of 1,024 sand-colored tiles. Clear connected tiles of one color and the tiles above tumble down like real sand. Clear again during the wobble to extend a chain. The demo runs until the board has been refilled five times.

title: Emojix Demo
description: A cozy puzzle game about emoji blocks. Fit every piece on the board, deal with emoji that don't get along, and collect photos for your album. 16 levels, from easy to tricky.

title: Tide Pools Demo
description: Try three shores of Tide Pools: uncover 15 seaside curiosities, improve your tools and fill a little museum with exhibits and visitors. A cozy, action-paced pixel-art incremental you can play at your own pace!

title: For Nora Demo
description: Shoot, dash, parry, and manipulate time in this thrilling action platformer as you race to rescue your kidnapped sister. you only have 1 week to save her, can you do it

title: Story of The Needle In a Haystack Demo
description: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

title: NekoTrak Demo
description: NekoTrak Demo lets you try a pixel cat desktop companion game. Raise a little cat that chases your mouse pointer, grows, gets hungry, and has its moods, keeping you company as you track your focus time and computer usage. Care for it, complete focus tasks, and watch it grow alongside you.

title: Tabletop Shop Simulator Demo
description: Tabletop Shop Simulator is a simulation game where you manage your store by offering tabletop gaming experiences to customers and selling collectible figures. Complete collections through your sales to earn rewards and grow your shop!

title: Don't Pick Up Demo
description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

title: OMG: Oh My Gravity Demo
description: Oh My Gravity (OMG) is a chaotic 4-player co-op 1st-person physics puzzle action game set in a spaceship gravity license test center. Utilize gravity guns, clays, and filters to engineer the perfect chain reaction. Experience hilarious physics disasters and true teamwork where no one is left behind!

title: BOB LOGISTICS Demo
description: Become the new picker at Bob Company's warehouse. Check orders, find and carry items, and pack them for shipping.
