Upgrade the warehouse to automate hauling and packing, clear your zone, and rise from Intern to Director. A relaxing first-person warehouse sim with no fail states or penalties.

title: System Arrival Demo
description: A top-down action RPG that combines dangerous expeditions into the outside world with bunker building, management, and defense against relentless attacks.

title: Dog Man: Bark in Action Demo
description: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure in the Dog Man: Bark in Action Demo! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.

title: In Silent Walls : Inside The House Demo
description: Red Hollow is waiting for you. In this demo of In Silent Walls: Inside the House, explore the first locations, uncover fragments of Daniel Mercer’s troubled memories, and try to understand what is real… and what no longer is.

title: Terrible Lizards Demo
description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

title: Put Your Toys Away Together! Demo
description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

title: Bunny Colony Demo
description: Cut and plant grass, guide your bunnies, and grow their numbers in this simulation puzzle. Clear traffic jams, supply food efficiently, and expand a colony that keeps multiplying through farming and breeding! How many bunnies can you make?

title: Everybody Loves a Good Hole Demo
Rhythm Roll Demo
description: Roll through a world of rhythm and light! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes as the challenge grows. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

title: Imperium of the Stars Demo
description: Build an empire, govern worlds, and command fleets in a single-player Gothic real-time 4X. Play as the Imperium for 50 in-game years with the Balanced Game Director. Your decisions shape a campaign of rival powers, unfolding events, and crises.

title: Panda Gambler Demo
description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

title: Squarelings Demo
description: A chaotic co-op puzzle platformer for 4–12 players, where every level is a new test of communication, teamwork and friendship.

title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout Demo
description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

title: Blu's Time Machine Demo
description: A retro-style 2D platformer where you flutter jump, propel and throw wrenches to defeat enemies and save the day!

title: Kira the Fox: Crystals of Harmony Demo
Heavy in the Hand Demo
description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

title: WarmSpot Demo
description: Play the first 30 WarmSpot levels for free. Place exactly one animal in every row, column, and pool, and never let two animals touch—even diagonally.

title: Decommission Protocol Demo
description: Edith station has been abandoned for a year - an unusually long time to sit derelict. You are a space station engineer sent up to decommission the station in a manual service elevator with the ability to stop between floors. Will you discover the truth or simply follow protocol?

title: Greedy Demo
description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

title: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room Demo
The Planet Miner Demo
description: Turn a tiny mining ship into a planet-shredding powerhouse. Dig through colorful layers, build game-changing upgrade combos, and let your drones join the fun. Experience this satisfying adventure full of sparkling treasure, adorable wildlife, and enormous buried wonders.

title: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes Demo
description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

title: The Cauldron Eats First Demo
description: Gather. Upgrade. Fight. Cut your way through the wilderness with a massive blade, build an army of workers and soldiers, and grow stronger with every upgrade through a vast skill tree. How long can you hold the light against the darkness?

title: Ecos de Valdrenne Demo
description: Demo of Ecos de Valdrenne: the whole of Chapter 1, “The Night of the Mark”. 10 of the game’s 153 rooms. A turn-based JRPG with a side-scrolling pixel-art map: what you cut on the map goes into the Resonator, and you fight it turn by turn when you decide.

title: Mad Cafe Demo
description: Serve coffee, pastries, and smiles to increasingly disturbing customers in this atmospheric psychological horror game. Keep the café running, master the perfect brew, and try not to lose yourself as each shift becomes more unsettling than the last.

title: Shadow Mist Idle Demo
description: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

title: Sugarstar Academy Demo
description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

title: Ruins of The Titan Demo
description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

title: Fast Movie Editor (FME) Demo
description: Edit multitrack timelines, explore Looks and color wheels, create titles and music visualizations, and review silence removal. Try Fast Movie Editor Demo to get a taste of the Complete Edition.

title: Cat's Fish Stall Demo
description: Discover dishes, open specialty shops, and connect them through customer flow. Combine up to 3 ingredients with a cooking method, choose facilities and timed events, balance traffic against profit, and clear 8 market scenarios—or test your own operating plan in Sandbox Mode from the start.

title: Tuggin It Demo
description: Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can! Unlock and purchase upgrades to make tuggin it go a little smoother!

title: Logisticats Demo
description: Take over a derelict floating island and help its feline residents set up production lines and establish trade routes—Build a commercial kitty empire in this cozy business and trading sim!

title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball Demo
TIANMING: Three Kingdoms Demo
description: TIANMING: Three Kingdoms is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set in the Three Kingdoms era. Lead heroes from different factions, build powerful decks and unique teams, defy fate on a perilous journey, and forge your own legend!

title: Yeet the Demo Chest
description: Play as a Mimic in a dynamic physics platformer! You have no legs, so aim and hurl yourself upward. But remember: every wall touch and enemy hit costs you gold. Calculate your momentum, protect your coins, and help the lonely chest break free!

title: 重制十七岁 Demo
description: Remake17 is a galgame. You play as student Liang Yu, who travels back to high school ten years ago after an accident. Amid memory and reality, you'll find overlooked traces and the fates of three girls. Facing reality and illusion, regret and dreams, what will you choose?

title: Roma Eterna Sons of Mars Demo
description: Gather your legions, build defenses, and conquer territory for ROME! Explore a doomed world, research new technologies, and uncover the legacy of Mars. "Roma Eterna: Sons of Mars" is a strategy and tower defense game.

title: Desktop Arrow Defense Demo
description: "Desktop Arrow Defense" is an idle tower defense mini-game that runs on your desktop. It lets you work while watching your tiny archer defend against incoming enemies. Upgrade your character's attributes, collect and enhance equipment, unlock skill combinations, and create your legendary archer!

title: HavenCraft Demo
description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

title: The Third Surveillance Bureau Demo
description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

title: Mine It All! Demo
description: Mine blocks across the screen, gather resources, and upgrade your tools. Build furnaces and automation systems to improve efficiency, then trigger chain reactions with special blocks to clear huge sections of the screen at once.

title: DESKTOP BUG KILLER Demo
description: Wildly satisfying incremental shooter! Gun down desktop bugs, farm resources to upgrade skill trees, and wield wild weapons like flamethrowers & exorcism cameras. Total stress buster for quick work breaks! Perfect casual stress relief game for your breaks.

title: Late Summer Demo
description: The story takes place in the summer of 2006. Mountain City Magazine received a mysterious photo, which led to a case of a missing actress...

title: Sin Return Demo
description: An obscure adventure begins in the Silent Kingdom, a land decaying under the spread of the Sin-fication plague. This dark fantasy turn-based RPG emphasizes exploration. Reclaim lost memories in this sinful land, defeat formidable foes, and piece together the truth behind the catastrophe.

title: BackroomsVR:Zero Demo
description: Immerse yourself in the psychological horror of the Backrooms and urban legends, in VR. No jumpscares — just the fear of truly being there. Watch your sanity… you wouldn't want to actually become one of them.

title: Blockmosis Demo
description: Blockmosis is a puzzle game exploring the intersection of problem solving and music making. The board is an instrument. Aim, rotate, and drop your blocks to create a unique song per level. Different game modes let you explore the intersection in different ways.

title: Warlords of Archaios Online Demo
description: Command the Kingdoms in this free demo of Warlords of Archaios Online. title: Toiletocalypse Demo
description: An absurd roguelike survival about fighting the runs during working hours. Drink. Work. Shit. Repeat.

title: Dawnbar Fantasy Demo
description: A world that forgot its own nameYour hero wakes alone in the Verdant Ruins — a green graveyard of a civilization no one remembers. DOSSIER 089 Demo
description: Take the seal for the nine-file opening of Protocol 089. Compare 27 records, expose nine contradictions, write binding orders, and discover why one citizen number belongs to more than one life.

description: A combination of roguelike and Match 3, Weaver's Oath is a game that focuses on building, skills and combos to achieve the ultimate goal to eradicate Corruption, while surviving long enough not to be swallowed by it.

title: Necromancer: The Fallen Serve Demo
description: Command a growing undead legion in a dark fantasy RTS where every fallen enemy can become your next soldier. Raise skeleton armies, harvest bones and souls, build your necromantic stronghold, and overwhelm fortified kingdoms through relentless conquest.

title: Goblin Colony Demo
description: Goblins live for about 20 days. Build a colony that outlasts them. Grow food, dig into the hillside, organize workshops and hauling, and prepare for raids. Raise the next generation and turn a woodland settlement into a fortress of their own.

title: WORKS: Motorsport Factory Demo
description: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage — scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.

title: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered DEMO
description: A demo of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered. Experience a special demo version of the Battle of Hulao Gate while playing as Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Xiahou Dun, Zhen Ji, Zhou Yu, and Sun Shangxiang.

title: Jin Ping Mei: Qinghe Reverie Demo
description: Experience the opening of a narrative simulation RPG set in Northern Song China, featuring relationships, investigation, management, and branching storylines.

title: Gacha Fiend Demo
description: Try the first three installments of Gacha Fiend. Shake the machine, open capsules, seal macabre cards, and face the first Brass-Basher before Mr. Ossório comes to collect.

title: MECH DISTRICT DEMO
description: Build factories, route resources with autonomous Hauler Bots, defend District Zero from PigDude raids, and deploy Raidframes and Superframes into turn-based combat. MECH DISTRICT is industrial automation where every production problem eventually becomes a combat problem.

title: Mini Me-Mao Demo
description: A mini companion DEMO that lives right on your desktop! Unpack and decorate a cozy desktop dollhouse, dress up your mini, and watch them paint while you work or play. Sell their art for gold, unlock new painting styles, collect charming decorations, and create the perfect space that grows with you.

title: Blobituary Demo
description: A 2D party game for 1-4 players, on the couch or online. Shove, brawl and betray your way through 13 mini-games in the world where cute blobs go to die.

title: Somnia Demo
description: Somnia is a first-person psychological horror game where you wander through endless hallways, encounter strange entities, and search for mysterious eyes while uncovering the truth behind a nightmare. This demo features the game's first five entities, the tutorial, and a main level.

title: Shatterflap Demo
description: Fire bouncing balls into towering ceilings of ice, carve open new ricochet paths, and rescue hidden penguins including rare Gold Penguins. Earn Coins, unlock the Charged Shot and turn simple shots into satisfying chains of shattering chaos.

title: Mimicry Kingdom Demo
description: Piece yourself together and explore a strange world in the Mimicry Kingdom demo. Collect body parts, explore, and fight—solo or online with other demo players. Try it to check performance and connectivity. Boss gates are unavailable.

title: Road of Life Demo
description: A narrative-driven truck driver simulator set within a historically reconstructed World War II setting, taking place on the route across Lake Ladoga (“Road of Life”) during the Siege of Leningrad.

title: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse Demo
description: Restore a lighthouse to prevent a disaster that already happened.

title: 60 Below Demo
description: 60 Below is a first-person atmospheric survival horror game where you must bring back power to a large underground facility engulfed in an unnatural cold mist, in order to escape its deadly, freezing confines you find yourself trapped in.

title: BONEYARD BOUNCE! Demo
description: Fire spell-balls from all four paddles and clear the graveyard of monsters! Block breaking, evolved into a monster shooter. Hit a weakness and the blast chains through walls, taking the whole horde with it. Fun even with bad aim. Escaped monsters strengthen the next graveyard — you pick the order.

title: Nightbound Demo
description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.
