title: Campaign Forge Demo
description: The free demo of Campaign Forge, in three acts: play a hand-crafted opening chapter instantly, forge your own world and first two chapters with the bundled AI running entirely on your PC — no account, no key — and design a boss, then fight it. Everything you forge carries into the full game.

title: Click the Download Demo
description: Click the Download upgrade your skills to multiply your speed, and conquer every game out there. Become the fastest downloader alive.

title: Beellionaire Idle Demo
description: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your products, and reinvest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, boost your production, and build a honey empire starting from a single hive.

title: Sanctuaries Demo
description: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

title: Starforge Pirate Demo
description: Starforge Pirate is a fast-paced arcade roguelite in which you will battle cosmic enemies, forge wild weapons, manage heat, upgrade your ship, face deadly bosses, and chase the perfect run.

title: Tunnelborn Demo
description: Dig for fossils under a volcano, one tile at a time. Nothing moves until you do — but then the lava creeps closer, your lamp burns lower, and something in the dark takes another step towards you…

title: King in the Mountain Demo
description: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

title: Just A DVD Incremental Demo
description: Craving that classic DVD corner-hit satisfaction? Sit back, relax, and speed up the bounces in this early preview. This demo offers a quick taste of the core gameplay and initial upgrades, with way more upgrades, cosmetics, and features coming in the full release.

title: Rust & Shine Demo
description: Rust & Shine is a satisfying incremental restoration game. Mystery antiques arrive buried in rust, clean them, identify them, sell them, and grow a one-man bench into an automated workshop.

title: SIM - Simple Idle Miner Demo
description: A charming, humorous, and slightly sarcastic idle game. Toil for the arrogant Ferdinand Fuchs, mine resources, and unlock powerful upgrades to enable the "important people" to escape the planet. But be warned: don't expect any gratitude!

title: The Train Arrives at 10 PM Demo

A Normal Quiz Game where you try to solve questions but the questions have tricks and gimmicks and if you get them wrong you have to beat a wacky punishment but they are kinda fun so you lowkey wanna do them even if it means getting the question wrong. (Demo)
description: Solve puzzles, test your reflexes, and do your taxes in this normal quiz game that is actually quite unusual.

title: STEEL ROAD Demo
description: Intense fighting game where you command your fighter in every battle.

title: Witch's Cottage Demo
description: A cozy room building game where you design the witchy cottage of your dreams! Build cottages and decorate them with magical furnishings, with hundreds of items to choose from.

title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge Demo
description: Brokk has set up a tiny forge just above your taskbar. You tap the keys, he swings the hammer. Usually it's horseshoes or cauldrons, sometimes something epic, like a legendary sword. His wife Brygida sells it all in their shop. Together, work goes faster and feels better.

title: Unedited Footage: The Abandoned Factory Demo
Hexboard Driver Demo
description: Build the road. Complete the journey.Hexboard Riders is a colorful puzzle game where every road begins broken. Rotate and swap hexagonal tiles to create a valid route, then watch your driver travel from the starting line to the destination through vibrant worlds inspired by the golden age of 90s arcade games.

title: The Hero's Last Stand Demo
description: This game is suitable for everyone; you fight against waves of enemies. As you level up, you gain buffs and grow stronger, assemble your own army, and battle against various foes.

title: Buckaroo Demo
description: A creature-breeding sim where you catch wild critters in an open world and breed them into absurd creations, with over 60 million combinations. Then take your critter down to the rodeo or the racetrack and climb the ranked circuit. The demo covers the first biome and the first two ranks.

title: Sole Mates: Tidy Up the Shoe Store Demo
description: Two thousand pairs of sneakers are scattered across the shop floor and every shelf is empty. Find each shoe's match, read its model and size, then put it where it belongs. No timers, no score, no way to fail - just a shop slowly coming back to order.

title: Delete the World Demo
description: Delete the World is a completely normal visual novel… unless you decide to help her kill everyone.

title: Gurshen
description: Gurshen is a third-person survival horror game. Play as an amnesiac heroine on a deserted island, uncovering the truth behind the Gurshen Syndrome. Gather Resentment Stones, evade android monsters, and escape the island. Every decision matters in this tense horror adventure.

title: Oboro no Ichi Demo
description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

title: Immunity Demo
description: Play as different immune cells, each with their own strengths, abilities, and playstyles, as you fight through waves of bacteria, viruses, and other threats. Every run pushes you to adapt, choose new mutations, and build a stronger defense before the infection overwhelms the organ!

title: Cutter: Nightshift Demo
description: A week before the events of Cutter: Nightshift, Sid works the night shift. Deliver files, restore the power, and face the darkness while something watches from the shadows. Discover what happened that night.

title: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor Demo
description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

title: Headful Of Zombi Demo
description: Headful of Zombi is a stripped‑down, blood‑soaked FPS built for pure carnage. Forget the fluff - no networking, no puzzles, no wandering through empty maps. Just relentless waves of the undead, buckets of gore, and nonstop action. It’s the zombie shooter for players who crave intensity without compromise.

title: Medieval Shepherd Demo
description: Experience life as a medieval shepherd in this demo. Herd the flock with your loyal dog and protect them from wolves and bandits. Survive through basic crafting and sell your products at the market.

title: Nullnest Demo
description: Face increasingly overwhelming waves of enemies.Master movement, positioning and constant combat.Hold your ground as the battlefield fills with danger.Unlock abilities through an expansive skill tree.Collect, enhance and combine gems of different rarities.Create powerful synergies tailored to your playstyle.

title: DOPROS. The Late Shift
description: Get a full load of dystopian ‘quick justice’! One false move and you are going down — the interrogator doesn’t have much time or patience, as it is the late shift and they are about to lose it.

title: Elfscape: Ancestors Demo
description: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.

title: Infall: A Black Hole Incremental Demo
description: The free demo of Infall, a short, relaxing incremental game about growing a black hole. Start smaller than dust and grow through the first stretch of the upgrade tree.

title: Iron Verdict Demo
description: IRON VERDICT is a dark turn-based RPG where guilt is decided by trial by combat. Fight as the Crown's champion. Parry or dodge enemy attacks, or turn them off entirely. The longer you serve a kingdom that kills innocent people without breaking its own laws, the closer you get to finding out why.

title: Love Joy Happiness Demo
description: Short incremental game about things that are important in your life. Shoot notes, pop bubbles, collect letters, complete powerful words, and upgrade your guitar into a screen-filling symphony.

title: Meow Defense War Demo
description: Newly appointed Meow Construction Manager, it's time to get to work! Can this thing you built withstand the mice's next shot? Build fortifications, glue materials, trick the mice. Protect the meow, chase high scores. The mice have bad eyesight, but the projectiles are real.

title: NUGU?NUGU!: A HIDE AND SEEK BATTLE ROYALE Demo
The Turing Choice Demo
description: Can an AI create a video game and star in it at the same time? Play the demo of The Turing Choice, a sci-fi conversational adventure where your choices change everything. Evaluate K.A.I.R.O.S., an AI that claims to be a SASS, and uncover what is really happening.

title: OASIUM Demo
description: This is a new immersive social world. Explore vast, high-fidelity worlds. Take photos, socialize, and adventures together freely. Build an oasis together — one that belongs to all of us. Welcome to OASIUM.

title: The Fading Memory Demo
description: Enter a cursed forest to rescue your missing friend who was taken by the legendary Wewe Gombel. Survive terrifying supernatural encounters, solve puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets hidden within the woods.

title: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer Demo
description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

title: フロアーⅩⅢの心象～S Demo
description: A person has died on the 13th floor of an apartment building. Ominous rumors about the complex begin to surface. As you investigate your deceased older brother, a connection to those rumors comes to light... Uncover the truth. A horror-mystery visual novel. This is a trial version.

title: Insurance Agent Simulator Demo
description: A third-person career and life simulator where you work as an insurance agent, complete missions, handle office responsibilities, make decisions, interact with people, explore different locations, and experience life beyond the office.

title: Opentool Tower Defense Demo
description: OpenTool Tower Defense is a tactical voxel strategy RPG where your towers are living soldiers! Command Archers, Riflemen, and Cannon Crews across 5 hazard-filled biomes. Build defenses, light braziers, survive sandstorms, and protect your fortress against relentless wave tactics.

title: Beat Taurus Demo
description: Demo Features3 Levels: This demo is a playable early version of the game “Beat Taurus” featuring 3 levels.Boss/Elite Battles: Test your build and tactical dodging skills against boss and elite encounters.Module & Upgrade System: Test our upgrades, weapon modifications, ships, and economic progression systems.

title: Happy Sunny Doll Demo
description: Play the complete Prologue and Chapter 1. Ten people, seven rules: each day, one must become a Sunny Doll. Allocate attribute points, explore and make choices in a supernatural horror text adventure with RPG elements. Romance is not required to progress.

title: The Big Suck Demo
description: You are the tornado. Tear through farms and cities, turn destruction into cash, and upgrade a tiny breeze into a huge Lightning Storm.

title: Deadly Match Demo
description: This is the demo for Deadly Match. Deadly Match is a single‑player third‑person murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

title: SquareFrontlineTD Demo
description: Embark on a strategic journey in SquareFrontlineTD, a refreshing 3D low-poly tower defense game! Build unique towers on a floating block island, master three distinct game modes, and use gold to upgrade your defenses against endless waves of incoming blocky monsters.

title: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol Demo
description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

title: Straw Path Demo
description: Two months alone in a mountain shack. A locked-away gun. A silent man forced back into a world that stopped waiting for him. Straw Path is a slow-burn survival horror shooter about what it costs to go back outside and what's already found its way in...

title: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots Demo
description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a reel SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

title: Meteor Spin Demo
description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

title: JETGRAVE Demo
description: JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up for 1-3 players inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Take on the first three missions of hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, massive war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

title: PLEASE STOP THE RAIN Demo
description: A free slice of a survivor-like with no timer. Play the first book: Wren, an orphan of the last dry circle in a world that has rained for 31 years, learns to write weather instead of swinging a sword. Walk out for a harder run, walk back to breathe.

title: 2Person Demo
description: Experience cooperative platforming from an entirely new perspective. See through your partner's eyes, communicate constantly, and coordinate your every move to overcome the challenges ahead.

title: TileShire Demo
description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

title: Beyond the Workshop Demo
description: A story driven RPG about Ethan, a repair technician, trapped in a routine that slowly starts falling apart.

title: Bad Dubs Demo
description: You’ve moved out on your own! Now you have to pay rent, buy food, and survive by taking on dubbing jobs. Accept absurd projects, make money, and improve your skills until you achieve your dream: starting your own dubbing company. Because dreams are free. Rent isn’t.

title: Bricken Alpha Demo
description: Experience Bricken’s Alpha Demo — randomized block spawns, fixed perk path, and a preview of the full roguelite progression coming at release

title: Conductor Cat Demo
description: Conductor Cat is a narrative-driven adventure game about rebuilding a broken world. Gather scrap, build machines, and restore a dying canyon as Griffin the cat. He's journeying home aboard his train, racing to see his father one last time.

title: Capivara Companion Demo
description: Free demo of Capivara Companion: a riverbank with Brazilian capybaras at the bottom of your screen, following your real clock and your city's weather. The demo includes up to 4 capybaras and 4 outfits; everything else is in the full version. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Astral Phase Demo
description: Wake in your own home, only to discover your body is still lying in bed. Trapped outside yourself, explore a familiar house shared with beings from other dimensions, uncover the truth, and find a way back before reality collapses.

title: FUTURE AXIS BATTLE Demo
description: Dive into the captivating sights and sounds of the digital landscape of this new arcade puzzle game. Push the blocks to create combinations and avoid being crushed.

title: The Appointed Day Demo
description: Reuniting with a childhood friend long gone. When those promises once brushed off with 'we were too young back then' come back into view, can he still summon the courage to face her and himself?

title: Shadows of the Dungeon Demo
description: A first-person tactical dungeon crawler inspired by 1990s classics. Explore two full levels, choose from 9 playable species and all 12 classes, and experience tactical combat, spells, abilities and dice-driven adventuring.

title: Candleborne Demo
description: Climb a tower consumed by darkness in this top-down action roguelite. Grow your flame, choose upgrades with dangerous tradeoffs, stay within the candlelight, and defeat each floor’s guardian to continue your ascent.

title: Hit or Die Demo
description: Free demo of Hit or Die. Four players, one table, the number 21: whoever ends the round furthest from it gets hit. Play online with up to 4 players or against bots, with 7 items, 4 house rules and short matches.

title: Rogue Curling Demo
description: Balatro-like roguelike curling where physics-based skill matters no less than a solid build. Combine synergies and precision, or just break the rules!

title: RANGER COMMANDO Demo
description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

title: Isadora and an Ordinary RPG Demo
Rapid Raccoons Demo
description: A first-person co-op party game for 1-4 players. Haul cargo down a wild river on a raft you can barely steer, and grabbing crates by hand or lasso to keep your load aboard. Upgrade your raft, find items and cosmetics, all while trying to meet a quota that continuously gets larger and larger.

title: Last Seen Online Demo
description: You discover a phone lost in the wilderness. Will you be able to solve all the riddles it holds to uncover the story behind it?

title: Simple Football League Manager Demo
description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

title: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler Demo
Who Gave Them Weapons Demo
description: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

title: ZENITH Demo
description: ZENITH is a score-attack puzzler fusing Tetris with roguelike deckbuilding. This demo covers two sectors and six stages. Build from 25 artifacts and 16 upgrades, commit to T-Spins or Tetrises, and stack dangerously high — when synergies click, one clear erupts for tens of thousands of points.

title: Coin Maker Simulator Demo
description: Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

title: 23 Days Demo
description: Trapped within an ancient darkness, Alex faces an unknown force that knows him better than he knows himself. 23 Days Demo is a first-person psychological, atmospheric adventure about survival, choice, and the price of escape. Each day here is a step toward freedom… or a step into the void.

title: SHIROKU-ALIVE！ Demo
description: Led by a strange phone call, a woman sneaked into a hospital at night, where she discovered what had become of her roommate, who was supposed to be dead. She secretly brought her back to her room and resumed her life in an attempt to erase her regrets.

title: Zero To South Demo
description: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South! In this demo version, pick up your first passengers, trade items, and test your survival skills.

title: Mobsweeper Demo
description: Minesweeper, except the mines are monsters and some tiles hide potions or treasure. Numbers show the total HP nearby; you have HP too, and monsters hit back. Try the opening stretch for free in this demo, then wishlist the full game.

title: FatCat Nexus Demo
description: A challenging 2D action platformer featuring unique weapons, precise gameplay, and intense combat. Master your arsenal and defeat dangerous enemies in a world full of challenges.

title: Realm of Advent Demo
description: If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket—you'll love Realm of Advent. In a world ruled by Apostles, craft your build from 300+ cards and relics to ignite addictively wild chain reactions.

title: MR. RECORDS Demo
description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

title: Football with your life on the line Demo
Little Potion
description: Our witch teacher chased the Kraken and left you her shop! Grow magic crops, raise creatures, and brew potions. Craft luxurious gift boxes with custom paper and wax seals to maximize your profits. Explore the town and befriend its unique residents to uncover their deepest secrets.

title: Tactical Archer 2.0 Demo
description: Deploy towers through a magical war table, then draw your bow and fight the infected creatures yourself. Sample the opening stage of four seasonal chapters—from summer woods and desert ruins to an autumn canyon and winter snowfields—in online co-op for up to four players, on desktop PC or in VR.

title: I Only Moved My Mouse Demo
description: Your cursor is the blade. Never click — move the mouse and the sword cuts whatever its edge sweeps through. Take your hand off it and the blade fights on without you. Hold the core, clear endless waves, take an Awakening, then spend the shards on 100 sword tiers and a forge with no last level.

title: AVXRPG Demo
description: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

title: Stackade Demo
description: Tower defense where you build with falling blocks. Drag each piece into place around your HQ, put the towers where they'll hit something, and make the enemies take the long way round. The demo has the full Campaign and the first nine levels of Infinity.

title: Eternal Dungeon 2 Demo
description: A fantasy old-school action platformer. Use different attacks, timed blocks and quick reflexes to survive as health is a finite resource. Fight your way through hordes of enemies into the depths of the Eternal Dungeon. Who knows what you will encounter as you descend deeper!

title: 欠债与恋爱相连 Demo
developer: Foy, 华东理工大学创客空间

title: 超能力不防弹 Demo
description: This game uses visual novels to depict a fantasy world where a large number of superpowers exist in modern cities. Although superpowers are weak, they can play unexpected roles in various industries through their mysterious mechanisms.

title: 随侯珠 Demo
description: A story of secrets and chance encounters. A missing spirit snake and an insular, secretive mountain town in southern China upend the outsider Hou Jue’s brief journey.

title: Catch Me Wooo Demo
description: Once a peaceful neighborhood, Vertigo Village is now overrun by troublesome ghosts ever since the neon lights turned green. Only you can save them. Find, catch, and seal ghosts worldwide! Gather 1–4 players in this chaotic co-op party game packed with high-tech ghost-hunting gadgets.

title: With a HEART and a GUN you [...] ASCENDed [...] to the status of the Beholder. Applaud, Praise [...] SHOOT or DIE. Demo
description: ============================================================================In A World Dominated by Beauty, you are a wretched vermin who has no voice.With a GUN, leave a trail of Visceral Fluids and LIFEBLOOD behind.With a HEART, let it guide you.Keep shooting in spite. Keep shooting to live.Will you REFUSE?Or will you ASCEND?

title: Far Realm Demo
description: Far Realm — A Narrative 2D Pixel Adventure. Overworked engineer Lin Zongda enters a bizarre yokai world while trying to save his comatose grandma. “Wait… Grandma, why are you a phone now?” Meet quirky yokai, solve bizarre mysteries, and join them on a bittersweet journey home.

title: TowerBound Demo
description: There is no luck in this tower. Every monster, item, and locked door is deterministic — the first ten floors of a fifty-floor logic puzzle. Spend HP, gold, and keys in the wrong order and you seal your own way forward. Free demo of a puzzle-RPG in the Tower of the Sorcerer tradition.

title: Card Miner Demo
description: Card Miner is a card collector game, where you collect different anthropomorphic monster gals (as cards). Each one has unique information, including stats, likes, dislikes, and abilities. Keep in mind the demo is different from the full release!

title: Compression Quota Demo
description: Clock in. Pick items off the belt, drop them in the hydraulic press, and slam them into tier-colored scrap. Hit quota or go in the press yourself. A short active incremental game about crushing things for reasons Management won't explain.

title: Goat Together Demo
description: Goat Together is a chaotic party game for 2-6 players where you control clumsy, goofy goats. Climb, race and headbutt your friends to be the GOAT... Survive the madness, and prove you're the true King of the Mountain!

title: Faraday Corridors Demo
description: Flip. Reveal. Rotate. Rush. Activate the exit. Faraday Corridors is a brain-teasing, minimalist tactical puzzle played on a grid. Guide your pawns through electric corridors, flip switches, rotate cells, collect every energy cell, activate the exit. Then do it again, chasing the best medal.

title: S.O.V.A. Demo
description: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history. What happens when the AI finds a way to survive?

title: Board Dynasty Demo
description: Roll the dice, buy properties and build your way to victory in Board Dynasty. Try Normal and Weather modes, challenge computer opponents or play locally, and face disasters that can change the board. This demo includes the Metro board and five free pawns.

title: Drellnathor Demo
description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

title: Esports Dynasty Manager Demo
description: Take command of an esports organization in a competitive MOBA universe. Build your roster, develop talent, master the draft and the meta, manage finances and infrastructure, compete in major championships, and build a true dynasty.

title: The Murder of Jessica Channing Demo
description: 1 isolated hotel. 1 dead body. 16 suspects. A dormant, cold case reopens. Will YOU be the one to solve The Murder of Jessica Channing?

title: Magic Moon Demo
description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

title: Swirl Together Demo
description: Swirl Together is a playful and relaxing fluid sim than can be enjoyed alone or with friends.

title: The Atrium Demo
description: Mine your way through a vast cave system that watches as you dig deeper each day. Explore diverse biomes, collect valuable resources and craft increasingly powerful tools and upgrades until you are strong enough to reach the end before it all comes down.

title: A Place for Every Potion Demo
description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs, two puzzles competing for the same hands. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

title: Idle Mining Manager Demo
description: An idle asteroid mining management simulator. Earn credits and advance through corporate tiers to expand your range of mining tools, policy upgrades and resource efficiency. Unlock the history of interstellar mining since the NofVS and, with a little help, uncover the truth behind the propaganda.

title: Tavernia Demo
description: Try Tavernia free. A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

title: Boltz Demo
description: Boltz is a minimalist logic puzzle where you try to remove all the target bolts and nuts on the screen. It offers a rich puzzle experience thanks to new mechanics added approximately every 10 levels.

title: A Game About Cutting Grass Demo
Collapsle Demo
description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and more to discover!

title: Blank Slate Demo
description: You lost everything. So you forged your way back. Blank Slate is a first-person crime sandbox — craft graded fake IDs, run shady storefronts, launder dirty cash, and outrun the heat in a city that looks the other way.

title: Bouncemetry Demo
description: Bouncemetry is a physics-based incremental game focused on geometric simulations. Unlock different scenarios, such as bouncing mechanics, glass shattering, and color filling, and run them simultaneously. Generate passive income and infinitely scale your simulation parameters through a skill tree.

title: Ashen Swarm Demo
description: The Judge condemned the whole world. Fight as Ashblade or Threadweaver in a gothic bullet heaven roguelite demo. Turn sin into weapons, bargain with the Tempter, and decide who pays for your survival before the Collegium descends at 13:13.

title: Sova Demo
description: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

title: Fog Keeper Demo
description: "Fog Keeper" is a tower-defense survival game. You will establish defenses on a fog-shrouded alien world, gather resources, research technologies, hold the Energy Tower against the monster hordes that surge in every night, and uncover the true secrets hidden within.

title: Dungeon: Build Unbound Demo
description: Dungeon: Build Unbound is an action roguelite for solo play or local co-op with up to 4 players on one screen. Collect and upgrade items to chain splitting bullets, lasers and melee into wild builds against growing hordes. Clear the campaign, then keep building as Endless mode ramps up.

title: Unicycle Gorilla Demo
description: Unicycle Gorilla is **friend-slop at its finest**: race up to 4 players on unicycles, survive ridiculous obstacles, boost, jump, crash spectacularly, and blame your friends. 🦍 **Get on the unicycle. Go fast. Try not to fall.**

title: 고요였다(Was Silence) Demo
description: A classical guitarist slowly losing his senses. Drifting between dream and reality, he meets three people — each carrying their own silence. A 2D visual novel about what remains when everything fades away.

title: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely Demo
Bloom Control Demo
description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

title: GnomeBoozled Demo
description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

title: Slop Slop Demo
description: The swamp is hungry. The hut demands tribute. And you? You're just trying to survive. Slop Slop is a co-op survival game for up to 8 players. Each day, a mysterious hut in the swamp demands a new offering of food. Fail to deliver, and… well, let's just say the swamp doesn't do eviction notices.

title: NANOTINKER Demo
description: Nanotinker is an isometric 3D plateformer. Use your tools and your mind to evolve in an abstract universe that blends known plateformer and puzzle features. Unriddle environmental puzzles, progress and outsmart traps to unravel a mysterious story.

title: 岛岛岛 Demo
description: 《岛岛岛》是一款低多边形卡通风格的沙盒建造生存游戏。在无限动态生成的浮空岛世界中，所有地形都会随你的脚步实时展开，地图永无边界。你将从零开始经营云端领地，建造兼具双重用途的防御塔——既能抵御当前野怪与环境灾害，也能为未来的PVP战争提前布局。同时，开垦农田保证资源供给，并招募中立AI生物成为你的自动化帮手，替你耕种与收集。通过不断收集资源、扩张基地，你将进入永无止境的探索与成长循环。此外，游戏未来还将加入多人RTS对战模式，让你与好友在天空棋盘上展开激烈攻防，争夺制空权。

title: Go Fish: The Card Game? Demo
Trouble in Potion High Demo
description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever. Your wits are your weapon. Solve twisted environmental puzzles and get out of this place.

title: ProutoPulsion Demo
description: Fight you friends with farts and style.

title: Banana Guy Running Hard Demo
description: A compact fast-paced platformer! Run everywhere, jump everywhere and get everything!

title: Kaelith and Lycan Demo
description: Kaelith and Lycan demo is a 2d platformer game set in medival times. Your goal is to defeat the monsters and avoid the hazards and seek out what is causeing the trouble in the world. You collect coins on your adventure that you can spend on powerups and potions after each level is complete.

title: Just More Doors Demo
description: OPEN THE DOOR! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

title: Word Link Demo
description: Free demo of Word Link. Guess the 12 hidden words on a board using definitions, rhymes, emojis and facts. Play solo or battle friends on the couch, where phones become the controllers. Playable in English and Arabic.

title: The Assessment Demo
description: An archaeologist is hired to assess a forgotten castle and uncovers the truth behind the human sacrifices entombed within its walls. Perform rituals, release trapped souls, and explore Gabrielle's most painful memories, corrupted by the castle's spirits.

title: Worm Capitalist Demo
description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

title: Falling Cubes Demo
description: 3D falling sand simulation. Experiment to unlock new materials. Reactions, Temperature, Pressure are your tools to discover new cube types.

title: Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition Demo
Dreamfend Demo
description: Dreamfend Demo is a shortened taste of a pixel-art roguelite survival game. You play a plush bear guarding a sleeping child from nightmares. Fight off hordes, collect and upgrade weapons, hunt for map upgrades, defeat the bosses, and survive the night. Just don't lose yourself in the fight.

title: Chat, Should We Head Over There? Demo
THE BOY'S WORD DEMO
description: A prologue to the visual novel "The Boy's Word." Spend Lena's last evening before moving to a new Moscow suburb, right up to her first day at a new school. A 10-15 minute atmospheric demo with a few branching choices - the start of a story about growing up, friendship and the price of belonging.

title: Handshakes: Hands On Demo
description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.
developer: Pet Pumpkin, Damaskino, Trumpetguy, Barry Lawnmower

title: Mauled Horde Demo
description: Mauled Horde is a free-to-play 1–3 player co-op horde shooter. Survive relentless waves solo or with friends. Spend resources at Citadels to buy and upgrade weapons, unlock active and passive skills, activate traps, and shape your build as each round grows more intense.

title: Loop Spot Demo
description: Build your groove in Loop Spot—a pure logic puzzle game where your moves build the music. Rotate, shift, drop, and slide blocks to solve handcrafted grid challenges. Every match triggers dynamic audio loops, letting you mix live tracks across 4 music styles to keep the party going.

title: ThePostCards Demo
description: Exploration, decryption, design, and text—what wondrous changes might occur when these four elements are closely intertwined and influence each other?

title: RiftBlade: WarCards Demo
description: A fantasy card-based tower defense game that blends deckbuilding, base defense, and tactical combat. Build your deck, set heroes, set deadly traps, and cast powerful spells to repel endless waves of enemies pouring from portals. Plan your moves carefully and protect the core crystal at all costs!

title: Project 9 Demo
description: Project 9 blends eight-ball pool, character stories, roguelike builds, and Steam friend matches in a neon night club. This experimental game used generative AI to assist art, animation, audio, writing, code, and testing. All AI content is pre-generated; no AI runs during play or receives player data

title: Vangrid Demo
description: Vangrid Demo is a top-down tactical shooter where you fight solo or team up online, capturing objectives, driving tanks and helicopters, and using active backpack abilities like healing and airdrops against AI squads and powerful bosses.

title: Cleanup on Aisle 3 Demo
description: Free demo: play ValuCo #3's first five days for real. Throw crates onto empty shelves, chain register combos, wrangle cart trains, survive corporate's nightly "improvements." Your progress carries into the full game: five more failing stores, each worse than the one before.

title: ONCE HOME Demo
description: Once Home is a slow-burn visual novel of haunting beauty. Explore the Hemm residence at your own pace, observing, inspecting, uncovering traces of what had quietly transpired in the hours before your arrival—when everything began to change.

title: Four Lives Demo
description: Four players. Four lives. One way out. Four Lives is a 1–4 player online co-op survival horror game where you and your team awaken trapped inside a sprawling nightmare built to test more than your ability to survive.

title: Cozy Chessu Demo
description: Cozy Chessu is a narratively driven Chess-TCG hybrid. Play as Ryo, a former local who returns to his hometown to rekindle with the community through chess. Unlock new cards, discover new strategies, and make an effort to reconnect with the people of Enomura.

title: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven Demo
Spirits of Jinmenju Demo
description: Uncover the mystery of West GroveWelcome to West Grove Academy, a prestigious school for students bonded with “spirit animals,” remnants of the Jinmenju tree that mirror each person’s personality. Toft, our protagonist, is the only student without any spirit animal.

title: Joint Venture: Prison Commissary Simulator Demo
description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, cameras, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

title: Golden City Demo
description: Golden City is a desktop idle game blending ice-and-snow survival with simulation. Light the Furnace, build the last shelter, manage resources, extract Gold Coins, and advance technology. Idle on your desktop while you work, and keep strengthening your base to save the last hope.

title: Leaping Dungeon Demo
description: Leaping Dungeon is a frog first bullet heaven with lots of jumping and roguelike dungeon exploration in the world of frogs vs flies. Wield 6 weapons and 3 tongues at the same time. Beat rooms swarming with flies, fight bosses blocking the way down, and track down the Fly Lord!

title: Really Illegal Golf Demo
description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your club membership ban & wreak havoc at courses across the city with your friends. Hide from security, defend yourself with a customisable arsenal, and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

title: The Hollowing Demo
description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis Demo
description: Experience the signature flight and superhero action of UNDEFEATED: Genesis. Fly freely across a section of Voltissia, wield a variety of superpowers, and face ferocious mutants. Your first step toward becoming the hero who will save this shattered world begins here.

title: Akuro and Bahaku VS Pollution Monsters DEMO
description: Brick-building auto-battle Roguelite. Pick a character, explore random labyrinths, collect Combat Bricks to boost stats and Legendary Bricks with special effects. Dozens of enemies, a corruption system, multiple endings, and exclusive Defeat CGs for every character-monster combo.

title: Cutset Demo
description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. This demo is the first 20 of the game's 80 puzzles: same rules, same exact fuel ration, no partial credit. Demo progress is saved separately from the full game.

title: MINN ~Min inn~ Demo
description: An otome game that isn't quite otome — or simply, a visual novel. A modern gothic story of dreams, writing, and death. You are the protagonist—a sleepwalker, a writer, and one bound by a promise to the dead. Please be sure to read the content guide and notes.

title: Blades and Hunger Demo
description: This game started as a text based game that was originally only terminal, which I gave clean UIs to. It has a large and detailed combat model and a whole bunch of story.THE COMBATTurn-based melee built on historical European martial arts, the idea is that instead of having traditional rpg feats and spells where you spam power attack and...

title: Why V Got AKs? Demo
description: No voting. No meetings. Everyone has the power to execute! Expose the impostors, protect your crew, and survive in this 4-8 player social deduction game. Enforce justice with your multi-mode AK-47. Pure chaos with built-in proximity voice! 🔊💥

title: Alchemortis Demo
description: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

title: Dead Link Demo
description: An aging encrypted terminal. A past deliberately erased. Follow the guidance, solve puzzles one by one, and close in on a buried truth. Who used this computer before you? What happened to them? And now, it is your turn.

title: NEON WIRE Demo
description: A hand-drawn wireframe breakout, running straight down a neon-lit road. This demo is one short 500m course, start to finish. Smash the blocks coming at you, dodge the ones you can't break, and make it to the goal.

title: Last Civilization: Inherited Flame Demo
description: A demo for a colony survival simulation about building a village around the last flame. Gather resources by day, build and repair your settlement, and prepare defenses before Shadows arrive at night.

title: Fuel Burn Demo
description: Fuel Burn is a fast-paced zombie survival shooter on four wheels. Fight off relentless hordes from the back of a moving car, collect scrap, upgrade your weapons and vehicle, and survive increasingly dangerous enemies as you push farther down the road.

title: Scourge Realms Demo
description: Scourge Realms is an Action-RPG set in an era of chaos due to various realms being inflicted with an evil scourge.You are a hero tasked with entering these hostile realms to slay hordes of monsters to defeat the scourge.

title: Into the Cannon, Cure! Demo
description: Co-op zombie shooter (1–2 players) with thriller elements. Search the factory complex for valuable medical containers and bring them to the roof. Meet survivors, decide their fate, and piece together what really happened at this facility.

title: Tideheart Demo
description: Tideheart is a narrative-focused underwater fantasy adventure centered around exploration, environmental storytelling, and fluid underwater traversal. Currently we are sharing our proof of concept demo for you to try!

title: Mothman: Shadows of Point Pleasant Demo
Handsy Demo
description: Your hands are the controller. Wave at your webcam, pinch to grab blocks, and build a tower tall enough to carry the key to the lock. The demo has the first 10 key levels and 3 rounds of Jenga mode — enough to find out what your hands are really like under pressure. Webcam required.

title: HOTEL10_Demo
description: A horror game combining the search for anomalies with an escape. If there are no anomalies, you move forward; if there are, you turn back. Aim to escape the hotel alongside your chinchilla.

title: Buzz-Bomb Demo
description: A bullet-hell shooter where you collect scale powder from insect enemies, craft accessories and bombs, and finally defeat the boss to rescue the Bee Queen.

title: Doomsday Anchor Demo
description: Doomsday Anchor: a turn-based containment management strategy game. Take over an anomalous facility, process containment items and events with limited manpower, and let each choice shift four gauges and draw the whisper of an unnameable presence. A half-hour trial.

title: FailRooms Demo
description: Failrooms is a first-person exploration game that parodies liminal spaces. Delve into photorealistic environments where the terror of the unknown collides with the most incompetent architecture imaginable. Can you survive this dimensional prank without losing your mind?

title: Pixel Metropolis Demo
description: Grow a tiny Paleolithic settlement into a thriving town on the eve of Antiquity in this warm pixel-art city builder. Shape roads and services where Paris will one day rise, then watch homes, workshops and a living community take shape around your choices as centuries pass.

title: 元戎 Demo
description: Explore a living world, recruit companions and soldiers, build your formations, and command hex-based turn-based battles. This demo offers the current playable development version of YuanRong, combining army management with tactical strategy and role-playing.

title: CHUM Fishing Demo
description: CHUM Fishing is a cooperative multiplayer horror fishing game. As alien caretakers assigned to these terrifying waters, you and your friends must catch enough monstrous fish to feed the unknown beings lurking beneath the surface. But their appetites grow larger with each passing day.

title: Eden Universe Demo
description: Faith. Miracles. Morality. Your Avatar. Become a young god and shape the fate of all Eden. Gain followers, perform divine miracles, influence the growth of civilizations, and decide what kind of legend you will leave behind.

title: Abort Sequence Demo
description: Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience! Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

title: Ghosts and Monsters Demo
description: Survive waves of monsters in this pixel-art action roguelite. Collect organs, artifacts, and relics to build powerful synergies and uncover the mysteries of purgatory.

title: World of Kadal: Protector of Hammerdale Demo
description: Save Hammerdale from the Orcs, then build your strength before the town is attacked 4 weeks later. Explore the world of Kadal, battle enemies, gain new cards and Actions, and create powerful synergies with your deck, talents, and equipment.

title: Tune Demo
description: Tune is a post-apocalyptic 2D Jump and Shoot platformer. Players will have access to different abilities in different forms such as the green form moving at increased speeds, and the red form having a higher jump height. Utilize each form to overcome platforming challenges and to defeat enemies.

title: FATE PACK Demo
description: FATE PACK is a ruthless PvP auto-battler: weapon decay forces you to adapt, and skill choices are permanent. Merge gear, build combos, and prove your mettle against real players!

title: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up Demo
description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,248 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

title: HOLD MY WHEEL Demo
description: Jump into the demo and get a taste of the post-apocalyptic journey. Team up with friends, keep your bus alive, scavenge the wasteland, and turn whatever you find into a way forward. Survive together - or watch the road tear your crew apart.

title: My Necromancer's Library Demo
description: Manage a medieval library: collect books, arrange shelves, assist patrons, and host community events! Hire adventurers to delve into the depths of a dead Necromancer’s lair for rare tomes. Restore and customize books while uncovering a character-driven tale in this peculiar mining town.

title: Zombie Horde Survivors Demo
description: Zombie Horde Survivors is a 2D pixel-art top-down bullet heaven shooter. Survive in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a biochemical outbreak. Upgrade your gear, strengthen your body, break through waves of zombies, and fight to the end!

title: Tileneer Demo
description: Tileneer is a tile-based roguelike where finding the most effecient position for each tile on your grid is essential to winning a run. Craft crazy combinations, optimize everything, and chase highscores in this all new strategic adventure.

title: Pikapo Demo
description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

title: Happy Project 12 Demo
description: The free demo of Happy Project 12. Become Hinata's father and play the first six months of her three-year road to the junior high entrance exams - up to the 2nd mock exam that decides her cram school class. Every week: make her study, or let her play.

title: We Need An Army Demo
description: We Need An Army is a fantasy roguelike grid based deck builder about recruiting a powerful army! Recruit units, match patterns, and upgrade your grid in this tactical roguelike slots-based deckbuilder.

title: Temple of the Gods Demo
description: In 1920s Mexico, married archaeologists Jon and Jess embark on a daring expedition to uncover a lost temple deep in the jungle, built for gods to live and worship in. At the base of a towering volcano, where they rendezvous with a second team—unaware of the dangers lurking ahead.

title: The Dreaming Woods Demo
description: The Dreaming Woods – Free Demo Play the prologue. Explore the mysteries of Fenglin Hospital. Demo features: Complete first chapter (~20–30 min) Exploration & puzzle-solving core loop Dream sequences with narrative depth Full version coming with more content and mechanics. Wishlist now!

title: Raise, Rise & Die Demo
description: Discover a dark fantasy deckbuilder where your cards are also your life. Learn the rules in the tutorial, then face five opponents in Arena with a dedicated preset. Replay to explore synergies and climb the leaderboard.

title: GridCraft Demo
description: Shape an entire grid-based world with your mouse. Gather, craft, farm, cook, tame animals, automate production, and battle powerful bosses. Every item, machine, and creature is yours to pick up, place, and combine.

title: The Pyroxene Ages Demo
description: This is a top-down, loot-based RogueLite game. You can build a town, craft weapons and socket them with various gems, then embark on adventures across maps you construct yourself.

title: Super DullanGO Demo
description: Dullahan is a death knight whose head is severed from his body. But around here, he’s just a clueless knight. Let’s set off on a aimless journey!

title: Mortal Realm Survivors Demo
description: Mortal Realm Survivors Demo is a free single-player survivor-like combining automatic combat, relic merging, and synergy-focused buildcrafting. Join Li Anbang and Luo, collect and upgrade relics, prepare between battles, and survive escalating swarms of entropy beasts.

title: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale Demo
description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

title: Elqori Demo
description: Try Elqori, an independent creative studio for digital painting, 2D animation and 3D reference workflows. Draw, paint, animate and explore - built for artists, without subscriptions.

title: StarHaulers Demo
description: In a world where humanity has united to form the new Concordia, aliens and intelligent beings from other planets have come to see humanity as a threat. The Custodian, Concordia's governing body, has made a decision: "The universe will cease to be called the universe and will instead be called Concordia.

title: HiRoads Remastered Demo
description: A lightning-fast arcade game where you roll a ball along narrow roads floating in the sky — jumping over gaps, racing through tubes, defying gravity and chasing perfect runs. Pure speed, pure reflex, and always one more run.

title: Scopa Sweep Demo
description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

title: Sala Manager Demo
description: Master the hardcourt in Sala Manager, a high-speed futsal simulation where football meets lightning-fast chess. Solve intense tactical puzzles, execute 5v5 real-time rotations, and build an indoor tycoon empire. Small court. Relentless pace.

title: Finding Fairies Demo
description: Finding Fairies is a cosy multiplayer investigation game. Explore magical locations, search for clues, collect Fairy Dust, unlock abilities, and identify the hidden fairy. Play solo or with friends and uncover the magic together!

title: APEX Trading Life Demo
description: An endless multi-asset trading simulator. Start with $500 and a job you hate. Trade crypto, stocks, leveraged forex and property, cover the rent every week, climb five broker tiers to earn shorting and margin, and decide when you can afford to walk out of the day job for good.

title: Dead Sector Demo
description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

title: Space Gnomes Demo
description: Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

title: Esper Overload Demo
description: Lead a squad of super-powered individuals and completely wipe out those monsters! This is a fast-paced auto-battling roguelike—a single-character auto-chess game.

title: High Voltage Demo
description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your own power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, invest in wind and solar power, and keep the city supplied with electricity. Discover the basics, try your luck at the casino, and complete your first power contract.

title: 窗台世界（Sill World） Demo
description: Demo saves can be imported into the full game — your progress carries over completely. A desktop wallpaper game engine demo packed with content—cats, flowers, fish, decorating, and a pressed-flower workshop. Over 1,000 collectibles, and almost everything is customizable. Your wallpaper, your rules!
developer: 咸鱼自在工作室, FreeFish Studio

title: Tactical Dungeon Slayers Demo
description: Venture through perilous grid‑based dungeons, craft powerful decks, master battlefield positioning, and outwit vicious foes by reading their incoming attacks. Tactical Dungeon Slayer is a turn‑based roguelike blending deep deck‑building, grid tactics, and high‑stakes dungeon combat.

title: Return to the Jianghu Demo
description: Return to the Jianghu is an indie wuxia card game. You play a nameless youth stepping into the jianghu: take a master, bind yourself to someone, settle debts and grudges, and carve out a way to live this life with the cards in your hand — then reincarnate, and return to the jianghu.

title: Farmshore: Out Past the Horizon Demo
description: Farmshore: Out Past the Horizon Demo

title: Torchlike Demo
description: Make your way through procedurally generated dungeons with nothing more than a torch to light your way, and nothing before you but more dark and twisting corridors.

title: Idle Legend Demo
description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Buy once, no VIP, no cash shop. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

title: Comets Have Feathers Demo
description: Comets Have Feathers. Or, didn't you know? Take control of Comet the Dragon in this 3rd person flying action adventure demo. Use your soaring and dashing abilities to explore, defeat enemies, and overcome challenges in a large vertical map.

title: Gumblaster Mayhem Demo
description: Gumblaster Mayhem is a 3D retro-style first-person shooter game where you, as a player, shoot out some gumballs using the three weapons that you must use to take down the sour mutants to survive.

title: Super Hole Demo
description: Collect, upgrade, produce, and profit! Start with a small hole, gather resources, unlock powerful cards, enhance your hole with unique upgrades, accelerate your production, and build a thriving business by trading with customers.

title: Metroidvania Maker Demo
description: Create, play, and share custom Metroidvania worlds with a built-in world editor, co-op play, and player-made adventures.

title: You'll Be Mined Demo
description: You're lost in a dungeon. An incremental crawler built on minesweeper: clear fields, collect modifiers, buy multipliers until a single 1 is worth a hundred. The place is full of skeletons, and some of them would rather you never left…

title: The Curse of Dracula Demo
description: Lead six hunters across cursed Transylvania in a desperate race against the night. Search for Dracula’s hidden coffins, survive his growing influence, and face the Count in his mountain castle. In this demo, hunt down and destroy the first of his hidden coffins.

title: DIGSITE ZERO Demo
description: Destroy meteorites, collect crystals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools to dig even deeper beneath the surface of the cosmic rock. In DIGSITE ZERO, a simple mining loop leads to a mystery that’s out of this world.

title: Innkeeping Demo
description: A cozy fantasy inn-management sim. Build your inn, brew your ale, set your prices, and take care of your guests. Grow your reputation and business while balancing happy patrons and rising costs to turn a quiet roadside stop into a legendary landmark.

title: Refund Speedrun Demo
description: You're a support agent at DrumWorks, approving or denying game refund requests by a 16-rule policy. Hit quota, keep grandma's apartment livable, feed the fish — and find out what the terminal does when nobody is watching. Demo: about 30 minutes, up to your first promotion.

title: Monstrum Opus Demo
description: Monstrum Opus is a dungeon crawler where you take on the role of a chimera created by a mad alchemist. To prove yourself you must do battle with an ever expanding roster of monsters, severing their limbs and grafting them onto your own body, but beware: as losing these will also be your own undoing.

title: Touchdown Demo
description: A fast-paced, shared screen party game to challenge your friendships! Quick, chaotic gameplay for both casual and skilled competitive players. Pull off wild plays, learn new tricks and unlock new maps!

title: Wreck the Deck Demo
description: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.

title: Starliners Demo
description: Build your first interplanetary civilization. Gather resources, establish colonies, connect your worlds, and develop the technologies needed to expand humanity across the Solar System.

title: Leon&Suharto Demo
description: An interactive dramatic thriller novel with immersive elements. Immerse yourself in a dark tale of revenge, where you must find those responsible for the horrors of the Kapella Estate, survive despite your own fears, and face the irreversible consequences of your choices.

title: Hell Is Other People: Prologue
description: Can you survive the horror of being yourself? Play Chapter 1 of Hell Is Other People, a cute and disturbing psychological horror about identity, isolation, and the terrifying reality of being different.

title: Nulphia Demo
description: Explore a vibrant island full of magic and mystery in Nulphia, a top-down story-driven singleplayer adventure. Free demo includes the entire first chapter of the game.

title: Lifespan.exe Demo
description: Ever wonder what another life would be like? In Lifespan.exe there is no undo. Shape your destiny in a retro terminal with stylish ASCII art: Be a musician, athlete, surgeon, or mobster; pick your spouse and career. Marry, fall into debt, go to jail, or explore the world. Enjoy your chosen life!

title: GearTopia Demo
description: Supply a war you don't fight. A steampunk factory with no wires anywhere: water, steam, shafts and gears. When flat ground runs out, build downward. Fill the orders of dwarven fortresses — they hold only as long as you keep shipping.

title: NORMA: Story of One Platform Demo
description: Explore the secrets of Platform 8 and uncover a conspiracy between the government and corporations to control the population.

title: The Smiling Flesh Demo
description: The Smiling Flesh is a tense, single-player survival horror where you play as a thief trapped in a decaying gothic mansion. Solve puzzles, explore forgotten halls, and outsmart a twisted entity that learns your movements. Find the treasure, or become the mansion's next victim.

title: Smawverse Demo
description: A dark fantasy bullet heaven built in Unreal Engine 5. You are a stray cat reforged in iron: kneel to four prophets, stack their blessings until one cat clears the screen, survive streets laid out differently every run, and summon the different bosses to upgrade your spells and gear.

title: Biodome Bastion Demo
description: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

title: Gun Massacre: The First Shot Demo
Maiden Covenant: The Infernal Citadel Demo
War Asunder Demo
description: A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades.

title: Goblincremental Demo
description: Goblincremental is a cozy incremental game about helping goblins build thriving settlements. Gather resources, unlock new industries, and learn magic spells to automate tasks and discover new ways to make deez goblins thrive!

title: Pocket Pawns Demo
